Umbhikisho ubuhlanganisa izinhlangano zosomabhizinisi ezehlukene okubalwa kuzo Isandlwana, Kojo, MKVA, Umlazi Business Forum neDelangokubona.Osomabhizinisi basuke eMoses Mabhida baya kobhikisha emgwaqweni uM4 basakaza udoti emgwaqweni.UMnuz Mandla Mhlongo, onguSihlalo weMlazi Business Forum, uthe sebesaba nokuphuma ezindlini zabo ngenxa yokwesaba abantu ababasebenzelayo ngoba sekuyophela izinyanga ezintathu bengabaholele wathi abakwazi ukuholela abasebenzi babo ngoba nabo abaholelwe. Uthe kuyabathusa ukuthi imenenja yedolobha ayifikanga ukuzozwa izikhalo zabo ngoba iMeya yeTheku, uNkk Zandile Gumede, yayithe uma benezikhalo mabazisiye kwimenenja yedolobha.Omunye wosonkontileka obekhona uthe bazoya ezindaweni ezinemigwaqo emikhulu eThekwini bachithe udoti kuzona.“Ngeke siphinde siwuchithe udoti eMlaza sesizowuchitha edolobheni ngoba izikhalo zethu azizwakali uma udoti siwuchitha eMlaza. Sizoya naseMhlanga uma bengazilaleli izikhalo zethu."IPhini lenhloko yezokuxhumana eThekwini, uMnuz Mandla Nsele, lithe osonkontileka abane abengamele umsebenzi wokuqoqwa kukadoti abaqashwe ngumasipala bakhokhelwe. Uthe osonkontileka abancane abaqashwe abakhulu abangeni ngaphansi kukamasipala, banobudlelwane babo bodwa.UNsele uthe bayaxolisa ngokuphazamiseka okukhona ngenxa yokungaqoqwa kukadoti.“Kwezinye izindawo kunokuphazamiseka kokuqoqwa kukadoti okwenziwa uphiko lwangaphakathi. EMlaza awuqoqwa udoti ngenxa yesimo esingesihle esidalwa wukuthi abasebenzi bethu bavalelwa emahhovisi eGarden Refuse kwa-V. Enye iloli lethu lashaywa ngamatshe ngoJuni 12. Sibe nenkinga efanayo ezindaweni ezisenyakatho lapho abasebenzi bethu abathathu balimala besemsebenzini nezimoto zethu zashaywa ngamatshe,” kusho uNsele.Uthe ngokulekelelwa amaphoyisa akwaSAPS nawakwaMetro bazoqala ukuthutha udoti eMlaza wathi bacela imiphakathi ibambisane nabo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa akwaMetro, uSenior Superintendent Parboo Sewpersad, uthe kube nokuphazamiseka kokuhamba kwezimoto ngemuva kokuthi kusaphazwe udoti emgwaqweni kodwa bekunezinhlelo zokuthi kube khona abazowuqoqa.

ABALANDELI beMeya yeTheku uNkk Zandile Gumede basabisa ngokuthatha izinyathelo uma ingabuyiselwa emsebenzini njengoba inikwe ikhefu ngemuva kwamacala enkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa athinta ithenda yezigidi yokuqoqwa kukadoti.Abalandeli bakaNkk Gumede izolo bebebhikisha edolobheni bezwakalisa ilaka labo ngemuva kokuthi i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal yelule isikhathi ikhefu lakhe kuze kube yenza isimemezelo ekuqaleni kuka-Agasti.Abalandeli bagasele emahhovisi kamasipala eCity Hall bakhipha abasebenzi.NgoLwesithathu babe nomlindelo bekhulekela umholi wabo.Ngaphandle kwaseCity Hall kusuke esinamathambo amaphoyisa abeqaphe isimo ededela isibhaxu kubalandeli bemeya kubalwa nezintatheli.Amaphoyisa abonakale ebamba ngesidlozane intatheli ye-Independent Media, uMnuz Sihle Mavuso oze waboshwa kodwa wabuye wadedelwa.Bayisikhombisa abantu ababoshiwe kubalwa nabaholi bemashi.Kuthiwa bathathu abalimele ngemuva kokudutshulwa ngezinhlamvu zenjoloba.Ababhikishi basuke eCity Hall baya eGugu Dlamini Park maqede baphikelela emahhovisi e-ANC.EGugu Dlamini baphakelwe ukudla ukuthiba iphango. Emahhovisi e-ANC akekho okhulume nabo basuka khona baya esiteshini samaphoyisa beyophoqa ukuthi kudedelwe abaholi ababoshiwe.Abazange bangene esiteshini eDurban Central ngoba amaphoyisa abesebalinde ngaphandle abahlakaza ngokudubula emoyeni, efutha nesisi esikhalisa unyembezi.Omunye okhulumela abalandeli bemeya, uMnuz Sduduzo Magwaza, usabise ngokuthi sebezothatha izinyathelo zomthetho uma ingabuyiselwa emsebenzi.“Into esilethe lapha wukuthi sizophoqa ukuthi imeya ivunyelwe iqhubeke nomsebenzi wayo,” kusho uMagwaza.Uthe banezinyathelo eziningi abangazithatha ukulungisa lolu daba.“Sizoqhubeka nokufaka ingcindezi sixoxe nobuholi besifundazwe ngoba thina singabantu abawuqondayo umbutho, uma singanelisekile ngesikunikwa wubuholi besifundazwe sizodlulela ebuholini bukazwelonke nalapho uma singagciliseki sizophoqeleka ukuthi sisebenzise umthetho, ngoba siyakholelwa ekutheni isinqumo sesifundazwe asikho emthethweni,” kusho uMagwaza.Izolo isimo besishubile eThekwini njengoba kuphazamiseke nokuhamba kwezimoto ngesikhathi kuqhubeka umbhikisho.Ngaphandle kwasesiteshini iDurban Central abalandeli bakaGumede bacishe babambana ngezandla namaphoyisa ngemuva kokuthi edubule emoyeni, bewasola ngokusebenzisa izindlela zamaphoyisa obandlululo.Khona izolo ngesikhathi kuqhubeka umbhikisho, kusabalale nemibiko ethi imenenja yoMkhandlu uMnuz Sipho Nzuza isisulile emsebenzini.UNzuza ungufakazi woMbuso ecaleni elithinta imeya. Okhulumela uMkhandlu weTheku uMnuz Msawakhe Mayisela uthe amanga aluhlaza ukuthi uNzuza usulile.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Thembeka Mbele uthe bayisikhombisa abantu ababoshiwe mayelana namacala okudala uthuthuva emphakathini.Uthe kukhona nentatheli eboshiwe kodwa yabuye yadedelwa.“Kunecala lokushaya nokudicilela phansi isithunzi eliphenywayo elibekwe intatheli,” kusho uMbele.

Namhlanje ngifisa sikhulume ngodaba lokuxolela bese sibheka nezimo ezivame ukubekwa yilo othi woniwe ezimenza angavumi ukuthethelela.Sike sathi sizihlalele sixoxa ngobunzima obake basivelela nezinye izinsizwa kwaqhuma izindaba ezihlekisayo abanye baze babalula nokuthi kunjani ukungaholelwa ngumqashi wakho kuze kwedlule usuku lomholo, kwaba khona nophawule indaba yokwephucwa emlonyeni lowo othandana naye.Kuzona zonke lezi zivuvaba ezihlukumeza abanikazi bazo, kube nesisodwa nje namanje engingakasithathi isinqumo sokuthi ukuba kwakuyimi owayebhekene nale mbedumehlwana nganginquma ukuthini.Woza nendlebe-ke (noma iso lakho) ngikuxoxele.Lo mlisa uthi wayevame ukugibela ibhasi lokuqala lasentathakusa njalo ekuseni uma eya emsebenzini.Kuthe langa limbe wavukwa yisisu ebusuku, lesi esiqala ngokubhavumula sikuvuse kube ngathi ushiswe yilahle lomlilo. Ziningi phela izinhlobo zokuphathwa yisisu, lesi akhuluma ngaso uthi uma sesikubambile ungaphambana nenyoka iza kuwe, uqonde ngqo kuyona uphinde uyeqe futhi maqede ungaqalazi emuva ukuthi iyakulandela. Uyaqonda-ke ukuthi bunjani lobunzima akhuluma ngabo.Uthi sam’bamba lesisu simkhipha waze washiywa yibhasi lokuqala ayevame ukulithatha. Ngenhlanhla wakwazi ukulinda waze wathola ibhasi elilandelayo. Ujabula nje kanti akabuzanga elangeni ukuthi kusekukhulu okuzomehlela.Nebala angene ebhasini abe nenhlanhla yokuhlala esihlalweni esingemuva komshayeli webhasi. Noma engakushongo lokhu kodwa ngiyasola indoda yasikhetha ngabomu lesi sihlalo ngoba ibheka ukuthi ukuhlala kwayo kuso kuzoyisiza.Lihambe ibhasi lithi nje lingafika endaweni eyigquma uma nje lithi thuthu lehla egqumeni ibhasi, kwasuka lokho. Ewu sathi isisu ngila, yathi le ndoda iyaziqinisa ibambelela esihlalweni iqinisa imihlathi, sathi isisu cha angenziwa kanjalo.Yaba yinye kuphela into eyayingenziwa yithi sonke, insizwa yaqunga isibindi yasukuma yaqonda ngqo kumshayeli iyomnxusa ukuthi amise ibhasi ukuze ikwazi ukwehla iyobhekana nale ngwadla. Okokuqala nje okwaba luphawu lokuthi idlozi layo liyifulathele, yathi ingakasibeki isicelo sayo, umshayeli washo ngesankahlu ukuthi “Wendoda, njengoba ubona kahle ukuthi akusona istobhi sokuma lesi, ubungelinde ngize ngime ukuze uzobuza ngoshintshi wakho ongaphele."Cabanga njalo ukuthi isisu asinamamenazi, asinanhlonipho. Yazama indoda ukuzikhalela ithi, "Mshayeli, awumise ibhasi ngikhishwa yisisu bo."Umshayeli waphendula ngokuthi kusemnyama ngeke akwazi ukuma esigangeni ngoba kuzobeka yena nabagibeli engozini yokubanjwa yizigilamkhuba.Yaqhubeka le ndoda ikhala ithi umshayeli akame okungenani uzoma maqede angalindi avele ayishiye khona lapho.Kwangathi nomshayeli uthelwe ngezibonkolo, etshela lo mgibeli ukuthi indlela ancenga ngayo sengathi iwubufakazi impela bokuthi kukhona amaqhinga ophezu kwawo, yikho kona kanye-ke, okwenza ayishaye ngamandla ibhasi.Ewu uyabona uma umuntu exoxa ngosizi lwakhe, niqale nonke ninsinsitheka nigcine senibona ethuthumela ukuthi lolo sizi alusadabukisi, kunalokho seluvusa intukuthelo.Akukho noyedwa owaba nesibindi sokumncenga umfo lo ukuthi akaxolele umshayeli. Kwathula kwathi cwaka!Emva kwalokho wonke umuntu wacabanga ukuthi uma kungenza lesi simo sibhekane naye wayengakwazi yini ukuthi avumele ukuthambisa inhliziyo axolele lo mshayeli?Ibuhlungu le ndaba ngendlela yokuthi akekho noyedwa kithi owabe esaqhubeka ebuza ukuthi ukwenqaba komshayeli kwaholela ekutheni yenze njani indoda.Kubili kuphela okunokwenzeka ukuthi kwagcina kwenzekile, okokuqala kungenzeka ukuba indoda yalahla ithemba yabuyela esihlalweni sayo yayobekezela kunzima kunjalo.Okwesibili-ke ngizocela ukuthi ngikushiyele kuwena ukuthi uzame ukucabanga ukuthi konje kwagcina kwenzekeni. Uma usuyitholile impendulo yesibili ngiyocela wenze kanje, ufike ungazise nami bese uqhamuka nesu elibukhali lokuncenga lo mnumzane ukuthi axolele loya mshayeli.Uma nawe wawungumshayeli wawungenze njani ngempela esimweni sokumiswa umgibeli kusempondozankomo sibe sazi ukuthi izwe selaba libi kanjani?U-Alex wethula uhlelo indaba emsakazweni iGagasi FM ngoMsombuluko ngo’7 kusihlwa bese ngoLwesibili kuya kuLwesine aqale ngo’6 kusihlwa. text: I-IFP KwaZulu-Natal ifuna amaphoyisa ampintshele ekhoneni, aze agonyuluke iqiniso umlisa oboshwe ngelezinsolo zokubulawa kwekhansela layo, uMnuz Mthembeni Majola (39). Ikhansela uMajola belisebenzela uMasipala iNkosi Langalibalele eMtshezi, lithelwe othulini ngo-Agasti ngesikhathi lihamba ngemoto yalo nomunye owasinda.UMnuz Ayanda Siyanda Mshengu Mvelase (26) uvele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMtshezi emuva kokuthelekelwa ezakwadalawane zamfaka ozankosi.Kukholakala ukuthi umsolwa oboshiwe, yiyona nkabi eyathela uMajola ngoyaba lwezinhlamvu yamshiya esethule. Ubhekene necala lokubulala nelokuzama ukubulala njengoba kukhona owasinda ehamba noMajola.I-IFP ikholwa wukuthi ukhona owayeqashe inkabi okufanele imcebe naye aboshwe.Uboshwa nje kuthiwa uhamba elinye icala eGoli lapho ezobuyela khona enkantolo ngoLwesibili.Kwelokubulala uMajola uzobuyela enkantolo ngoLwesibili oluzayo.USihlalo we-IFP KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thamsanqa Ntuli uthe bafuna iqiniso lonke ukuthi bekusukelephi kuze kubulawe uMajola. Uncome umsebenzi wamaphoyisa ngokubamba umsolwa kodwa wathi usemningi umsebenzi.“Kuyigxathu elihle ukuthi kuboshwe umsolwa. Kodwa sifuna umsuka wendaba nabo bonke ababehleli behlela yonke le nto.Ukubulawa kosopolitiki kuyinkinga kabi kulesi sifundazwe, akufanele sikuthathe kancane nje,’’ kuchaza uNtuli.Uthe amaphoyisa kufanele azihluphe ngokuthola obhongoza abaqasha izinkabi ukuze kuphele ukubulalana.UMajola ubulawa nje naye ubehamba icala ngezinsolo zokuzama ukubulala owayengusomlomo kaMasipala waseNdumeni, uNkk Winfreda Mbatha-Makhathini.UMajola kuleli cala ubeboshwe noMnuz Siboniso Mbatha, oke waba yimeya eNdumeni. Ukuboshwa kwabo kwashiya abaningi bekhexile ngoba bonke laba baseqenji elilodwa. UNkk Makhathini ube esefudukela kwi-ANC emuva kwesigameko.

ISIMISIWE emsebenzini iMenenja kamasipala waseJozini ngemuva kokukhala kwamakhansela ngo-R11 million osebenze kwakhiwa umgwaqo oyikhilomitha elilodwa eMkhuze nezigidi ezintathu zokulungisa amahhovisi omkhandlu.UMnuz Kuhle Khumalo umiswe ngoMsombuluko ebusuku ngo-9 ngemuva komhlangano wamakhansela obusemini. Umiswa nje bese kuqalwe uphenyo olwenziwa yiMunicipal Public Account Committee (MPAC) oluqalwe ngesonto eledlule.UKhumalo utshele Isolezwe izolo ukuthi akukho okuningi azokusho ngoba usaxhumana nabameli bakhe.“Ngithole i-SMS ngo-9 ebusuku ngoMsombuluko ebingazisa ukuthi sengimisiwe emsebenzini ngakho ngizocela imibuzo uyibhekise kwimeya ngoba mina ngimatasa ngixhumana nabameli bami ngalesi simo,” kusho uKhumalo.Ngesonto eledlule Isolezwe libike ngenkombankombane yaseJozini ephakathi kwamakhansela noKhumalo ngokusebenza kwezigidi zabakhokhi bentela.Amakhansela kaKhongolose nawe-IFP abeshaya amakhala ngemali yokwakha umgwaqo waseMkhuze abasola ukuthi imali yasetshenziswa budedengu.Amakhansela abuye asole uKhumalo ngokuthi “wadla” u-R3 million wokwakha amahhovisi kamasipala.Kuthiwa wanikeza usonkontileka imali umsebenzi ungakakhangiswa.Kuthe uma umsebenzi sekufanele uqale kwavela ukuthi usonkontileka akasakwazi ukuqhubeka ngoba imali idliwe uSars.UKhumalo ngakolunye uhlangothi uyacacisa ukuthi isinqumo sokwakha umgwaqo ngo-R11 million sathathwa emhlanganweni womkhandlu owawungomhla ka-12 Meyi 2017 lapho iMeya, uDelani Mabika, yasayina ukuba kwengezwe u-R3 million ku-R8 million okwakufanele wakhe umgwaqo.UKhumalo usola ukuthi umiselwe ukulwa nenkohlakalo eJozini.FUNDA:Umsindo ngekhilomitha lomgwaqo elibize uR11 millionUveze ngesonto eledlule ukuthi wavula icala koKlebe ukuze baphenye amanye amakhansela ngokunyamalala kuka-R5 million okwakuhlelwe ukuba kwakhiwe izakhiwo ezithile zomphakathi. Le mali kuthiwa yasayinelwa njengesebenzile kodwa izakhiwo azikaze zibe khona.IMeya yaseJozini uMnuz Delani Mabika ithintwa iqale yaba namancoko yathi ivukwa wumoya ngalolu daba.“Ngicela ungithinte emuva kwemizuzwana ngoba ngibheke eHluhluwe emhlanganweni ophuthumayo. Uma ungangithintanga kuqala nami ngizobuyela kuwe,” kusho uMabika.Kuthe ngemuva kwemizuzwana abeyibekile wathintwa kodwa ucingo lwakhe belumatasa. Ngemuva kwalokho beseluvaliwe kwaze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela engatholakali.Kwenzeka lokhu nje Isolezwe lithunyelwe umyalezo okhomba ukuthi ubuvela kuKhumalo ewuthumele kubaholi abathile bezombusazwe ebalisa ngesimo abhekene naso.Umyalezo uKhumalo uyawuphika uthi akawazi futhi akekho umholi amthumelele.Kulo myalezo kubhalwe ukuthi: “Laba bantu bafuna ukungimisa emsebenzini bangesulela ngezinto engingazazi. Bagxambukela nasemsebenzini wami. Bafuna kubenabasebenzi engibaxoshayo noma ngibehlise ezikhundleni ukuze kungene abafunwa yibo.”UKhumalo uthe akawazi lo myalezo kanti uqale ukusabalala emasontweni amabili edlule.
Njengoba umklomelo ohlonyuliwe kulikhishi likanokusho elakhiwe inkampani i-Tiger Brands Foundation, uhlelo lwesikole lokudla seluzoba ngcono kunakuqala.

AMAWELE adume kuma-Idols abuye ahlala isikhathi eside emzini womfundisi waseNigeria obhekene namacala okudlwengulwa, akhulume okokuqala ngakubize ngokuhlukumezeka kwawo ebandleni lakhe.U-Aneliswa noNelisa Mxakaza (22) baseMayville, eThekwini, bakhiphe isitatimende kuFacebook bexolisa ngokuvikela uMfundisi Tim Omotoso ngesikhathi eboshwa emuva kokubekwa amacala ngonyaka odlule. Amawele ahlala unyaka emzini ka-Omotoso eMhlanga engamalungu ebandla lakhe iJesus Dominion International.Ngesikhathi u-Omotoso eboshwa esikhumulweni sezindiza ePort Elizabeth ngo-Ephreli, elinye lamawele lamvikela isidana. U-Omotoso ubhekene noxhaxha lwamacala okubalwa kuwo awokushushumbisa abantu nawokudlwengula.Esitatimendeni amawele athe abefana nabantu abalahlekelwe yingqondo ngenxa yempilo abeyiphila ebandleni.“Siyaxolisa kubo bonke abesifazane ngoba besibukeka sivuna u-Omotoso emacaleni okuya ocansini abhekene nawo. Sithanda ukuxolisa nakulabo abagiliwe ngoba siyabazi bonke bafana nodadewethu. Asizange sibaseke ngesikhathi bebhoboza ithumba ngokuhlukunyezwa kwabo ngoba sasiphoqekile ukuvikela u-Omotoso kwabezindaba,” kusho amawele.Isitatimende siveza ukuthi bebephoqwa ukuthi bangakhulumi okubi ngo-Omotoso.“Besihlala ngokusatshiswa ngoba akukho ebesizenzela kona ngoba sithanda. Izikhulu zebandla zasenza sabaleka emakhaya sayohlala no-Omotoso. Njengoba besiyizingane besitshelwa ukuthi nguyena osondelene noNkulunkulu, okumele sidlule kuyena kuqala. Siyazisola ngokudela abazali bethu salalela umfundisi esingamazi waseNigeria.”UMnuz Mando Makhubela, amawele amjube ukuthi awakhulumele, uthe kusenzima kuwona ukuzikhulumela ngendlela ahlulelwe ngayo ngodaba luka-Omotoso. Uthe basazama ukuthi alulekwe ngokomqondo ukuze impilo ibuyele esimeni ngokuphelele. Uziphikile izinsolo zokuthi amawele, athe aphunyuka engakaze athintwe.“Kuningi ukuhlukumezeka ngokomoya abadlule kuko u-Anele noNeliswa kodwa abazange badlwengulwe. Bebexoxelwa ngamantombazane ngokwenzeka kuwo aze anqume ukubaleka. Bekunzima ukuphumela obala ngoba bebesatshiswa. Bebegadwa usuku lonke bephuma kuphela uma beyothenga futhi bephelezelwa,” kusho uMakhubela.Uthe akuzange kube nokuthula ekhaya kusukela amawele aya kwa-Omotoso, okuyimanje asazama ukubuyisana nomndeni. Uveze nokuthi ngesikhathi eyohlala kwa-Omotoso ayesebhalisele ukuyofunda e-University of KwaZulu-Natal kodwa kulo nyaka abuyele ekolishi ukuyofunda.Okhulumela ibandla, uMfundisi Sanele Myeni, uthe bazwile ngesitatimende kodwa ngeke baphawule ngoba udaba lusenkantolo. U-Omotoso uvele enkantolo ngoMsombuluko icala lahlehliselwa uMashi 6.Kuvele ukuthi sekuboshwe nabesifazane ababili okusolwa ukuthi ubesebenzisana nabo ukushushumbisa abesifazane.

Ube esesondela eduze kwami wakhipha ummese wathi angikhiphe yonke imali engiyiphethe. Wathatha uR1 100 obusekhukhwini lami. Bekunabagibeli kule tekisi, kuthe noma ngizama ukukhala ngangasizwa muntu, umshayeli naye wavele wayishaya yazula, wangamnaka. Kuthe uma ima itekisi umfana wehla, wabaleka. Obehlezi eduze kwami wazikhalela ngokuthi naye ubesaba ukuthi uzomphuca eyakhe imali uma engilekelela,” kusho uCele.Uthe okubuhlungu ukuthi umshayeli akazange amlekelele, kunalokho waba nezaba wathi akamazi lo scabha, wathi ubehamba yedwa, engenamsizi.“Umshayeli waba umuntu ongayingeni indaba yami, wathi akagadi abagibeli yena. Ngasala dengwane ngingasenalutho, ngihlukumezekile ngalesi sigameko. Ngifuna ubulungiswa,” kusho uCele.UMnuz Vusi Msani, wososeshini baseSouth Beach, uthe babikelwe ngalesi sigameko.“Ngashayelwa ucingo umshayeli engitshela ukuthi kunomgibeli okhala ngokuthi ubanjwe inkunzi esetekisini waphucwa uR1 100, kunabagibeli phakathi. Ngathi abaye esiteshini samaphoyisa bavule icala, baveza ukuthi amaphoyisa anqabile ukulivula icala umshayeli ehamba yedwa, bafuna ophucwe imali. Umgibeli ubevele eseyile kolivula icala.“Sibe sesicela lo mgibeli ukuthi eze ekomitini lethu elibheka izikhalazo zabagibeli, elihlangana njalo ngoLwesine kodwa wangafika lo mgibeli. Besifuna ukuthola okwenzeka njengoba osicabha bengasekho nhlobo lapha eSouth Beach, bamiswa ngoNovemba 1 ngonyaka odlule,” kusho uMsani.Uthe lolu daba bazolulandela.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Thembeka Mbele, uthe baphenya icala lokubanjwa inkunzi komgibeli esetekisini.“Ngokophenyo esilwenzayo umgibeli ngoFebhuwari 16 nonyaka, ngo-5.30 ekuseni wabanjwa inkunzi egibele itekisi, umsolwa wayehlezi ngasemnyango. Wamkhomba ngommese, wathatha imali yakhe. Icala lokubanjwa inkunzi livulwe esiteshini saseDurban Central, uphenyo lwamaphoyisa lusaqhubeka,” kusho uCol. Mbele.Imenenja ehhovisi leSantaco eKZN uMnuz Sfiso Shangase, uthe bayezwelana nalo mgibeli, wanxusa ukuba abagibeli beqikelele uma begibele amatekisi ukuthi bayazigada izimpahla zabo ngoba abanye abasuke begibele nabo basuke bengaziwa.Uthe bazolulandelela lolu daba.

Izindaba zokuthandana kukaNonka Chonco (24), onomuzi endaweni yabadla izambane likapondo eBallito noZuma (76), zavela sekubelethwe ingane esibhedlela esizimele saseHillcrest, iBusamed, ngo-Ephreli 12, okuwusuku okwazalwa ngalo uZuma. Bathi indodana yami ehlala eGoli esizokhulumela umndeni wakwaChonco. Baze bangitshela ukuthi uZuma usewukhiphile uR184 000, kwathengwa izimoto.”Uthe okumenze wafuna ukuphumela obala ngalolu daba ukuthi uyabona ukuthi uZuma uyamdelela njengoba engasafuni ukubonana naye futhi nendodana yakhe ithi ayisafuni ukuzihlanganisa nalolu daba, “kanti noNonka ubengasazibambi izingcingo zami futhi useyibhlokhile inamba yami.”UMNUZ Fartescue Chonco uthi usalindele uMnuz Jacob Zuma namademeshe akhe Isithombe:SITHUNYELWEKwenzeka lokhu nje uNonka usehlale efake indandatho. UChonco uthe uNonka wamhlawula futhi wamkhulisa esemncane waze wafundela umsebenzi eVarsity College. “Akakaze wafunda ezikoleni zabantu abamnyama kuphela kodwa ubefunda kwezixube izinhlanga kuphela. Ngisho nomama ohlola izintombi (uDkt Nomagugu Ngobese) wazi mina ngoba waze wafika nakwami ngiseseThornville, wafike wamyala ukuba aze angakuyeki ukuhamba uMkhosi woMhlanga.” Uthe washaqeka futhi kwaphela namandla uma ethola ukuthi indodakazi yakhe ithandana nomuntu omdala kangaka futhi onesithembu samakhosikazi angaphezu kukanina kaNonka. “Kodwa yayingasekho into engangizoyenza ngoba kwase kwenzekile.”Uthe wahlangana nonina kaNonka esahamba edayisa izingubo emigwaqweni futhi engumfelokazi wakwaNyathi.“Wabe esesebenza njengokhondathi wamabhasi ami. Savumelana ngokuthi sizothandana futhi ngimenzele konke kodwa ngeke ngimshade. Ngamfica esenezingane ezimbili zalapho ayeshadele khona,” kusho uChonco. Imizamo yokuthola kubo kaNonka nonina, uNkk Nombuso Mokoena, ayiphumelelanga kodwa okhulumela uZuma, uMnuz Ray Zuma, wenqabile ukuphawula, wacela intatheli inikeze inamba yakhe kuChonco (ubaba).Esethintwa uChonco uvumile ukuthi ukhulumile noRay Zuma okhulumela umndeni, kodwa wathi usazoxhumana noJacob Zuma.“Udaba ungaqhubeka nalo ngoba usengidelele kakhulu uZuma.” UChonco uze wakhombisa ithimba leSolezwe NgoMgqibelo izithombe zikaNonka esemncane futhi nomama omncane kaNonka.

text: I-ANCYL KwaZulu-Natal isiphumele obala yathi ifuna uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli ukuthi akhethwe njengoNobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal engqungqutheleni yesifundazwe okulindeleke ukuthi isingathwe ungakapheli uJulayi.Ekhuluma emcimbini wokusonga inyanga yabantu abasha ehholo lomphakathi iMichael Gwala eNtshangwe, uMgcinimafa we-ANCYL uMnuz Thobelani Ncampalala, uthe bafuna ukuthi abantu abasha bangene ezinhlakeni ze-ANC ukuze nabo bahlale etafuleni uma sekuthathwa izinqumo.“Yingakho siyi-ANCYL KwaZulu-Natal sithi sifuna uqabane uMdumiseni Ntuli akhethwe njengoNobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, asididekile ngalokho esikushoyo, uMdumiseni uke wahola i-ANCYL eKZN futhi uyiqabane ekade lalinethwa zimvula uphinde abeyisibonelo kithina, sifuna ukuba yisifundazwe sokuqala lapho uNobhala we-ANC esifundazweni kungumuntu omusha,” kusho uNcampalala.Uthe i-ANC eKZN idinga umuntu onjengoNtuli kwesikanobhala njengoba isemkhankasweni wokuqeda indaba yezinhlangothi.NoSihlalo we-ANCYL eThekwini uMnuz Thembo Ntuli uhambe emazwini kaNcampalala wathi bangajabula ukubona uNtuli engunobhala wenhlangano esifundazweni.UNtuli uphakanyiselwa esikhundleni obekuhleli kuso uMnuz Super Zuma. Nakuba liphakanyiswa igama likaNtuli kodwa akhona amanye amaqabane afuna kubuye uZuma.UNcampalala uqhube wathi enye into abafuna ukuyibona ukuthi uNobhala-jikelele we-ANCYL, uMnuz Njabulo Nzuza, akhethwe njengelungu lesigungu esihola isifundazwe.“Sifuna ukuthi uNzuza uma esebuya eLuthuli House eseqede ihlandla lakhe abuye KwaZulu-Natal azoba essigungwini esibhekelele ukusebenza kwesifundazwe, iProvincial Working Committee,” kusho uNcampalala. Uthe uNzuza usesebenze ezinhlakeni ezahlukene enhlanganweni waze wafika eLuthuli House.“Omunye umholi esifuna akhethelwe esigungwini esihola inhlangano nguSihlalo wethu esifundazweni uMnuz Kwazi Mshengu,” kusho uNcampalala.Uthe njengobuholi besifundazwe baphinde bavumelana ngokuthi baseke unobhala wabo uMnuz Thanduxolo Sabelo kwesikamengameli we-ANCYL njengoba kuyiwa engqungqutheleni ngoSepthemba.Uthe bafuna ukubona abantu abasha babambe iqhaza kuyo yonke imikhakha kubalwa ekuholeni nakwezomnotho.Isolezwe lizamile ukuxhumana noMdumiseni Ntuli ngenhloso yokuthola ukuthi uzamukela kanjani izindaba zokwesekwa wuphiko lwentsha kodwa ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa.

SINCAMELE ukulala emgwaqweni Siyokwenza inhlolokhono yomfundaze eGoli, isitshudeni sase-University of South Africa (Unisa), osekuphele iminyaka emithathu singayitholi imali yokufunda.USthembele Ngejane (25) waseMount Moriah, uphenduke isilomo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana emuva kwesibindi sakhe asikhombise ngesonto eledlule. Utshele Isolezwe ukuthi ubengeke aphuthwe yithuba lomfundaze akade ayewudinga. UNgejane ohlala nonina ongasebenzi nodadewabo ababili, waqeda * -matric ngo-2014 eShayamoya High eKokstad, nakhona awufunde esehlale iminyaka emibili ehleli ekhaya ngenxa yokulimala engozini yemoto. Uveze ukuthi sekukaningi impilo yakhe ibambezeleka kodwa akalilahli ithemba.“Ngaqeda esikoleni ngafaka izicelo emanyuvesi ngangazithola izikhala. Ngagcina ngibamba amatoho ezitolo kodwa ngingalilahlile ithemba lokubuyela esikoleni. Ngo-2016 ngamukelwa e-University of Johannesburg ukuyokwenza iHuman Resources Management, ngashoda ngemali yokubhalisa. Ngiphinde ngamukelwa e-Unisa nakhona kwaba nenkinga yemali. Bengifaka ngisho izicelo kuNsfas kodwa ngingaphendulwa,” echaza.Kubuye ithemba kuNgejane kulo nyaka amukelwa e-Unisa ukuyokwenza iNational Diploma in Accounting Sciences. Kuthe esabhalisa ngesonto eledlule wathola ucingo oluqhamuka kwaNYDA ukuyokwenza inhlolokhono yomfundaze abewucelile e-East Rand eGoli. Uthe kwale ngisho ecela ukuthi bamenzisele emahhovisi aseThekwini, bathi udingeka eGoli.“Ngishayele izihlobo ngizama imali, zonke zangichitha. Ngivele ngabhala ibhodi elithi ngiya eGoli ukuyokwenza inhlolokhono yomfundaze, ngama emgwaqweni onguthelawayeka ngoLwesine ebusuku. Bengingenalo ngisho isenti ephaketheni. Emuva kwesikhathi eside ngamelwa owesifazane, naye engangithembi ngoba esola ukuthi ngiyisigebengu. Ugcine engigibelisile wangishiya eGoli, endleleni wangithengela ukudla,” kusho yena.Esefike eGoli ubhale ekhasini likaFacebook lase-Unisa, abantu babheka inombolo yakhe kuFacebook wakhe, bamshayela bamfakela imali. Uthe imali ibingena ubuthaphuthaphu abanye bemfakela i-airtime neyokudla. Ugcine ethengelwe nethikithi lebhasi lokubuyela ekhaya ngoLwesihlanu njengoba ethi ubengazi ukuthi uzobuya kanjani.Kumanje uselinde impendulo yomfundaze kusukela ngenyanga ezayo. Nokho selikhona ithemba lokuthi lizofezeka iphupho lokuba yiChartered Accountant. Uveze ukuthi usebizwe komunye umhlangano ngesinye isikhulu kwezemfundo esimthembise uxhaso.

Okusiphatha kabi wukuthi izimoto ziyaboshwa, uShanela awuyingeni indaba yokuthi sisalinde amaphemithi. Siyacela iPRE isinike amaphemithi ethu.”UMnuz Bafana Mhlongo, uNobhala weSouth African Taxi & Transport Alliance, uthe ngoLwesibili iPRE ibihlangene nosomatekisi besifunda iGreater North okukhona kubo iNanda, KwaMashu nezinye izindawo ukuchaza ngezinhlelo zayo.“Sixakekile uma sesimenywa emhlanganweni ekubeni iPRE ingazikhiphi izimvume zethu zokusebenza. Eziphumayo ziyagqoza. Kuthiwa ezinye ziyadayiswa ngoR20 000. Akekho osichazelayo ukuthi izicelo zihamba kanjani. Asihambisani nale mihlangano ngoba ayizi nezixazululo ezinkingeni zemboni yamatekisi. Sinenkinga yamaphemithi, eyokungabikho koxhaso lwabagibeli nokubulawa kwabanikazi bomsebeni. Zonke lezi zinto zidinga ukuxazululwa,” kusho uMhlongo.UMnuz Mluleki Mntungwa obhekelele ezokuXhumana eMnyangweni wezokuThutha nokuPhepha koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uthe iPRE iqale ukuvakashela izifunda ezehlukene zamatekisi ngoJulayi ukuze ixoxe nabasembonini.Uthe kuyenzeka kuthathe isikhathi eside ukukhishwa kwezimvume zokusebenza kodwa lokhu kuya ngokuthi umnikazi wetekisi uyithumele yonke yini imininingwane edingekayo.“Kuningi okulandelwayo ngaphambi kokuthi kukhishwe imvume yokusebenza, njengokuthi kufanele umnikazi wetekisi alethe wonke amaphepha adingwa yiPRE, kufanele sithole ukuphawula kumasipala okusebenza kuwo itekisi, kufanele sithole isitifiketi sentela somnikazi wetekesi. Ngenxa yobuningi bezicelo zezimvume ezitholwe yiPRE kuvulwe amahhovisi azokhipha izimvume ePort Shepstone, Mbazwana, Ladysmith naseMpangeni. Lokhu kuzosiza abanikazi bamatekisi ukuthi bafake izicelo eduze kwalapho besebenzela khona bangayi eMgungundlovu bonke.”Uthe kunezinhlelo zokuvula ihhovisi lePRE eThekwini maduzane.UMntungwa uthe izimvume zokusebenza zinikwa abanikazi bamatekisi hhayi ososeshini babo ngoba kufanele bagcwalise amafomu okucela imvume, kucutshungulwe isicelo sabo, isicelo sibe sesishicilelwa kwiGovernment Gazette okuwuhlelo oluthatha izinsuku eziwu-21.Emuva kwalokhu kuhlalwa phansi kulalelwe isicelo somuntu ofuna imvume yokusebenza. Ithimba elilalela isicelo libe selinquma ukuthi isicelo siyaphumelela noma siyachithwa bese kukhishwa imvume yokusebenza uma isicelo siphumelele.Ugqugquzele osomatekisi abanobufakazi bokuthi amaphemithi ayadayiswa ukuba bathinte uMqondisi Jikelele wePRE, uMnuz SJ Langa, noma uMqondisi, uNkk N Majola, noma uMnuz S Ntuli ku-033 341 9500.Uthe bangathinta nehhovisi likaNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha ku-031 360 6576 noma ku-033 355 8760 nasemaphoyiseni.“Akudingeki ukuthi abantu bazidalule amagama abo kodwa bangacela ukufihlwa uma bevula icala emaphoyiseni noma bebika ehhovisi likaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal nelikaNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha.”Kulabo abathi amaphemithi ayadayiswa benganabo ubufakazi uthe kuyicala ukusola abantu ngenkohlakalo ungenabo ubufakazi.

INatu neSadtu ibhikishe ngaphandle kwesiShayamthetho bekhala ngothisha bakwaGrade R. BABHODLA umlilo onogada, abagada ama-ATM abathi bamuhluzwe ngamaphoyisa abecabanga ukuthi baziyizigebengu ezicupha imishini yemali, eMpangeni.UMnuz Mbongeni Gcabashe noMnuz Thembinkosi Ndlovu abasebenza enkampanini yonogada iTrinity Protection enenkontileka nabakwaStandard Bank bathi behlelwe yilesi sigameko bephuma kolungisa i-ATM yakwaStandard Bank , enxanxatheleni yezitolo i-Assenwood Centre, eseRichards Bay ngoLwesine ebusuku.UGcabashe obehleli esihlalweni somgibeli emotweni, engabhaliwe ukuthi eyenkampani abebehamba ngayo uthe uqaphele ukuthi kunemoto ebihamba ebibasola ngesikhathi besebenza.Lo mshayeli uthi bacabanga ukuthi ubikele amaphoyisa bathi akabuzanga lutho kubona, ubebabukile besebenza emshinini. Balinde kancane baphinde babuyela kuwo beqinisekisa ukuthi ngempela awunankinga yini njengoba ubuchwepheshe ababusebenzisayo bebukhombise ukuthi unenkinga.“Sihambe ibanga elincane singasayiboni le moto sabona kuqhamuka inqwaba yamaveni amaphoyisa ngemuva kwemoto yethu. Ebingaphambili isimisile, sama. Ngiphume kuqala ngaphakamisa izandla, ngiphethe ikhadi lokusebenza, angikwazanga nokubuza kwenzenjani, ngoba kuqhume impama, nebhuzu ngalahleka phansi nalo ikhadi ebengiliphethe,” echaza.Ngesikhathi esalele phansi uthe amanye amaphoyisa ahambe aya kuzakwabo obengumshayeli wabuzwa ukuthi kungani imoto abahamba ngayo ingabhaliwe futhi eqashiwe.UNdlovu uthe uchazile ukuthi inkampani ikwenza ngamabomu lokhu ngoba uma kunzeka behamba ngezimoto ezaziwayo bangaba sengcupheni yokudutshulwa yizigebengu.Ngemuva kwalokho bathi amaphoyisa abashiye kanjalo angachaza lutho futhi angasho ukuthi abaye esiteshini bayoveza bonke ubufakazi bokuthi bayasebenza.“Esiteshini samaphoyisa eMpangeni amaphoyisa abekhona asibuze ukuthi yithi yini ebesihamba ngePolo Vivo ebisolisa, savuma. Sabuza ukuthi kuthiwa siyasolisa ngobani athi kungene ucingo luchaza le moto njengesolisayo. Indaba yonakale uma sesithi sizovula icala ngoba sishayiwe. Amaphoyisa aphika ukuthi lawo maphoyisa abephuma kulesi siteshi, athi kungenzeka ukuthi sishaywe ngonogada abebesebenzisa izimoto zamaphoyisa. Kube umzukuzuku ukuthi sivule icala,” kusho Gcabashe.Uthe kwale noma sekufika umphathi wabo esiteshini ezobuza ukuthi kwenzekeni iphoyisa elithe liwukhomanda lanqaba negama lalo kodwa icala ligcine livuliwe.Okhulumela amaphoyisa kulesi sifundazwe, uCol Thembeka Mbele, uthe kuvulwe icala lokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza esiteshini samaphoyisa eMpangeni.“Lolu daba luthunyelwe ophikweni oluphenya amacala athinta amaphoyisa,” kusho uCol Mbele.

text: MHLELI: Ngivumele ngibeke umbono wami mayelana nohlelo oluvezwa kumabonakude olubizwa ngoTatakho, lapho kusuke kufunwa ikakhulukazi ubaba wangempela wengane.Zikhona izingane ezihlezi nobaba abangazizali kodwa abaziphethe kahle njengezingane abazizalayo, bese kuba khona izingane ezifika nomama emendweni kungezona ezasemshadweni. Kuphinde kube nezingane ezihlezi kahle zondliwa futhi zifundiswa ngobaba abangazizali kodwa futhi uthole ukuthi kwayona ingane yazi lo baba njengobaba wayo wangempela.Wonke umuntu uyadinga ukwazi ubaba wakhe, noma ngabe usashona noma ngabe usaphila. Kunezingane namuhla ezakhuliswa ngobaba abangazizali okunamuhla ziphila kamnandi ngoba zakhuliswa kahle.Kunezingane ezihlukunyezwayo kumanje okuthiwa, "Wena kawusiyena owalapha ekhaya, hamba kini!" Uthole ukuthi ingane kayilazi elinye ikubo yazi lapha, kanti umndeni usuyibukisisile, wazanelisa ukuthi kakusiyona eyalapha ekhaya.Kwesinye isikhathi izithandani ziyavumelana ngokuba nemfihlo lapho indoda izothatha unina nengane yakhe, bavumelane ngokuthi lolu daba kuzokuba ngolwabo bobabili.Ngesinye isikhathi uma ingane ikhula iye ifune usiko lwakubo. Yilapho ke iye igule noma kube khona izinto ezingahambi kahle kuyona, igcine isiya kulaba okuthiwa bayabona, abanye ke kuye kuthiwe bayabona kanti kababoni.Iqala lapho ke inkinga, ufike umntwana atshelwe lokho namuhla kusasa atshelwe okuhlukile, ekugcineni bese ehlasela umama wakhe. Umama uhlaselelwa ukuthi kungani engalikhulumi iqiniso achazele ingane ukuthi ingeyakwabani? Uthole abanye sebeludlulisela udaba kuTatakho!Yilapho ke ingane ithola amahlazo kamama wayo ukuthi walala namadoda amangaka, kanti futhi akayazi okuyiyona eyamkhulelisa. Nakhona lapho kuyenzeka amadoda awakhumbulayo umama ukuthi waya nawo ocansini abe mathathu, nakhona lapho uthole ukuthi imiphumela iyawaphika la madoda amathathu.Kwesinye isikhathi omama bezingane bayalala namadoda ahlukene bese kuthi uma esekhulelwe abheke indoda engakwazi ukondla ingane bese ethi iyona ke ubaba wengane. Abesifazane bajwayele uma kuzikhulunyelwa nje bese bethi bayamazi bona ubaba wengane, kodwa uma ulandela uhlelo uTatakho ugcina sewutholile ukuthi lokho akusilona iqiniso.Uma ke imiphumela yamadoda amabili noma amathathu iyilandula ingane, ibe ibihlala futhi yazi ukuthi ubaba wayo yilona oshade nomama wayo, ishona kephi? Umama wayo ushona kephi? Ubudlelwane bengane nonina buba kuliphi izinga?Kuhle ukuthola iqiniso kodwa elingeke futhi lakushiya nomlilo osuyokusha inguna-phakade! Uma singalandela ukuthi labo abaphikwe yimiphumela okusho ukuthi kumanje ababazi abobaba babo, baphila kanjani ke kumanje? Sizothola ukuthi isimo sibi kakhulu kunakuqala udaba lungakayi kuTatakho.Kuyingozi ukufunwa kukababa yingane, kungcono kune ngubaba wengane oyifunayo. Nakhona futhi lapho, ake sicabange, sekuthiwa mina noma wena, kunobaba othi mina ngiyingane yakhe ngoba balala nomama wami, nomama avume ukuthi walala naleyo ndoda! Umama osekuvela ukuthi walala namadoda athize ekubeni eseshadile, angeke esahlala kahle emzini. Mhlawumbe nje selokhu lolu hlelo lwaqala baningi omama asebethuthile emizini yabo bahamba, ngoba vese bakhombise ukungathembeki. Indodakazi yakhe eyenza uGrade 11 kukholakala ukuthi seyinezinyanga ezintathu ikhulelwe, akukaziwa ukuthi ubani oyikhulelisile phakathi kwakhe nesoka layo abeyiphoqa ukuthi iyolala nalo njalo uma eseyidlwengulile.Unina wale ngane (38) esalaliswe esibhedlela esingadalulwanga njengoba iselashwa nobengahlali nayo njengoba ahlukana noyise isencane uthe uthole ngeSonto ngokudlwengulwa kwayo.“Ngithole * -call back obuvela kwindodakazi yami ngeSonto ekuseni ngayifonela yase idlulisela ucingo komunye umuntu ongitshele ukuthi ngize ngizoyilanda esiteshini samaphoyisa ngokushesha. Ngize ngakwazi ukufika ebusuku ngoba bengisuka kude. Kuthe uma sengisendleleni ngaphinde ngashaya ucingo ngazama ukuthola ukuthi ikuphi yangitshela ukuthi isesibhedlela. Ngishaywe uvalo ngathi ayingitshele ukuthi kwenzekeni ngoba bebelokhu bengasho ngesikhathi beqala ukungifonela. Ibe seyingitshela ukuthi uyise ubeyidlwengula,” kusho unina wale ngane.Uthe ngesikhathi bebonana nendodakazi yakhe imbikele ukuthi uyise ubeyidlwengula bese eyisabisa ngokuthi uzoyithumelela ngezulu.Ubethi uma eseyidlwengulile bese ethi ayiyolala nesoka layo ngenkani ukuze kuthi noma ikhulelwa kube sengathi yilona.Uthe ingane yakhe itshele umngani wayo ukuthi uyise uyayidlwengula base beya kovula icala ngeSonto ekuseni emuva kokuthi egcine ukuyidlwengula ngoMgqibelo ebusuku.“Namanje ikhanda lami lisaphithene ngoba bengingazitsheli ukuthi kunento efana nalena eyenzekayo. Uyise wafika wazomthatha ekhaya ngo-2016. Bekungathi bahleli kahle kodwa kwathi uma ivakasha ngoJuni kulo nyaka ngabona sengathi kukhona okungamphethe kahle. Ngesikhathi ngimbuza uthe ukhathele ngoba ufunda kakhulu. Uthe uqale ukumdlwengula ngoMashi wathi wayesaba ukusho ngoba ubemsabisa,” kusho unina wale ngane.Uthe okumphatha kabi kakhulu ukuthi ugogo wengane ozala uyise uyamfonela amthuke njengoba eboshiwe. Unina wengane uthe ingane ithe ifisa sengathi uyise angayitholi ibheyili ngoba izibona ingaphephile uma engaphumela ngaphandle.Umthombo osondelene nalolu daba uthe umphakathi wakule ndawo usashaqekile mayelana nokuvela kwezinsolo zokudlwengula ezibekwe lo mthandazi okuthiwa ubehlonishwa endaweni.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt Col Thulani Zwane, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi lo mlisa uboshiwe nokuthi uvele enkantolo ngoLwesibili.Kulindeleke ukuthi umsolwa aphindele enkantolo ngoLwesithathu oluzayo ukuze afake isicelo sebheyili.

OWAYENGUMENGAMELI wezwe, uMnuz Jacob Zuma usazolinda uphenyo lweKhomishana kaJaji Raymond Zondo ngezinsongo zokubulawa abhekene nazo ngaphambi kokuba afake isicelo sokuba kwengezwe ezokuPhepha kuye.Lokhu kuvezwe umkhulumeli wakhe, uMnuz Vukile Mathabela emuva kokuba kube nezinhlangano eziphazamise ukuba kuqiniswe ezokuphepha kuZuma, ummeli wakhe u-Advocate Muzi Sikhakhane nomndeni wakhe uZuma.“UJaji uZondo ukucacisile kwikhomishini yakhe ukuthi lolu daba lwezinsongo zokubulawa ezibhekiswe kuZuma zizophenywa abaphenyi bekhomishini ukuze bathole ukuthi ziqhamukaphi.“Kuyothi uma sebesithulele umbiko bese uMengameli Zuma ethatha isinyathelo. Okwamanje lukhona uhlelo lwamaphoyisa ngokuphepha kukaZuma njengoba amaphoyisa ehlale emqaphile,” kuchaza uMathabela obexoxa neSolezwe. NgeSonto eledlule, inhlangano elwisana nezimpi zamatekisi KwaZulu-Natal okuwuBumbano lokuThula Forum, iphakamise ukuthi kuqiniswe ezokuphepha kuZuma. Ikusho lokhu esitatimendeni sayo emuva kokuba uZuma edalule kwiKhomishini kaZondo ukuthi kukhona abasongela ngokumbulala nomndeni wakhe.Usihlalo woBumbano lokuThula, uMnuz Andile Hlatshwayo, uthe babona kuyisikhathi sokuba uZuma avikelwe ngoba sekuyacaca ukuthi impilo yakhe isengozini.“Ngemuva kwezinkulumo ezethulwe uZuma kuKhomishini yokuLawulwa kombuso yiDlanzana ngoLwesibili, kusicacele thina njengoBumbano ukuthi uyakudinga ukuthola ezokuphepha ezengeziwe kulezi anazo. SEKUPHINDE kwaqubuka umsindo ebandleni lomfundisi waKwaNongoma, uKing Prophet Saziso Ndwandwe, iHealing Hour Emmanuel Prophetic Global Ministry ngemuva kokulobola ngosuku olulodwa izelamani zakwaMdluli eBhambayi eNanda.Ngokusho komthombo ongaphakathi egatsheni laleli bandla elikhonzela enkabeni yedolobha laseThekwini, kunabazalwane abangayizwa indaba yakhe yokuqonywa yizelamani uNondu noTho.Umthombo uthe uNdwandwe (36), obuye asakaze kwiNanda 84.0 FM ngamaSonto, waqala wathandana noNondu baze batholisana ingane.“Bahlukana noNondu engakabelethi. Uthe esuka wayegxumela kudadewabo omncane (uTho) wamphuca ubuntombi bakhe. Uthe esethi uyomlobola, abakubo kwakhe bathi akasale esebathatha kanyekanye noNondu. Yingakho-ke ephoqeleka ukuthi abalobole kanyekanye ngoR8 000 (okusho ukuthi uR4 000 umuntu ngamunye),” kusho umthombo.Uqhuba uthe okucasule abanye abazalwane futhi abaze bambizela emhlanganweni uNdwandwe ukuthi kunohide lwamantombazane obekwaziwa ukuthi ujola nawo futhi awathembise umshado.“Umfundisi useyaganga ngempela ngoba kunentombazane esimbekezelele kakhulu uSne Mgobhozi, sonke ebesesazi ukuthi uzoyithatha. Kunenye futhi eneminyaka engu-18 esisanda kuzwa ukuthi uyigqekeze wayishiya. Kukhona nenye efunda eMangosuthu University of Technology kodwa edabuka KwaHlabisa nayo ayigqekezile,” kuphetha lo mthombo.Enye yala mantombazane okuthiwa uyigqekezile, iziqinisekisile lezi zinkulumo kwiSolezwe ngoMgqibelo.Kodwa icele ukungagagulwa ngoba yesabela ukuthi unina usayazi iyintombi.“Umfundisi wakhuluma nomama ukuthi ufuna ukungenza enye yamakhosikazi akhe kodwa umama wanqaba.“Ngelinye ilanga sagcina silalile naye umfundisi kodwa ngathi angifuni ukushada ngoba ngisafuna ukuqhuba izifundo zami,” kusho le ntokazi eno-18.USne uvumile ukuthi uyathandana nomfundisi kodwa wenqaba ukuphawula ukuthi kumphathe kanjani ukulobola kwakhe izelamani.Imizamo yokuthola izelamani noNdwandwe ayiphumelelanga futhi kwahluleka ngisho sebethunyelelwa nemiyalezo.UNdwandwe uthe okwamanje ngeke akwazi ukuphawula kahle ngalolu daba ngoba kukhona okusamenze wamatasa, kodwa uzobuye akhulume naleli phephandaba. Phambilini watshela leli phephandaba ukuthi unoxhaxha lwezintombi enkonzweni ayiholayo. Wathi uyakholelwa kakhulu esithenjini, nasekuqonyweni futhi uyakholelwa kukhona. Wathi zonke izintombi namakhosikazi akhe, ubaboniswa wuNkulunkulu.Ngo-2005 washadelwa nguVelile uMaDladla kwathi ngonyaka olandelayo walandelisa ngoThando uMaNgcobo ngaphambi kokubalamanisa ngezingoduso okungoNksz Ntombifuthi Mfekayi (24) waseMtubatuba, uNksz Sinothile Ntshangase (24) waseNewcastle noNonhle Ntuli (22) waKwaNongoma.Wathi akagcinile kodwa usazokwengeza ngabanye ababili ukuze agcine enesithembu samakhosikazi ayisikhombisa, ngokomyalelo kaNkulunkulu.Wathi yena wasindiswa ngo-2007 futhi unamandla alingana nawomsunguli webandla lakwaShembe, uMqaliwendlela.UNdwandwe uqale ukuzakhela udumo ngokuzishaya isifuba ngokuthi welapha isandulela-ngculazi futhi atholele abantu imisebenzi ngamatshe.

SEKUPHELE amasonto amabili siduve emakhazeni isidumbu somfundisi waseMnambithi umngcwabo wakhe omiswe yinkosikazi endala ethole ukuthi idivoswe ingazi umyeni washada nomunye.UMfundisi Vika Mazibuko (46) webandla lamaZayoni elingatholakalanga igama lalo, washadelwa wuNksz Dumazile Vilakazi (45) ngo-2001. UNksz Vilakazi uthe owesifazane asebebanga naye isidumbu wafika ezokwelashwa, wagcina ehlala iminyaka emithathu ekhaya.“Ngagcina sengimthatha njengengane yami ngoba wazinikela nangokugcwele esontweni. Ngo-2007 umyeni wami wahamba nayo le ntombazane.”Uthe abazange badivose nomyeni wakhe, waqhubeka wahlala emzini wakhe. Uthole ucingo kuninazala wakhe emtshela ukuthi uMazibuko ushonile ngoJuni 24.“Ngaya lapho abehlala khona umyeni wami, umnakwethu wangikhombisa incwadi ekhomba ukuthi ngadivoswa ngo-2009. Ngithole ukuthi umyeni wami uphinde washada nayo le ntombazane ngo-2013,” kusho uNksz Vilakazi.Ngenxa yokumangazwa ukudivosa engazi, uNksz Vilakazi uye enkantolo wavimba ukuthi kudedelwe isidumbu. Uthe akaze awathole amasamanisi edivosi futhi kwakumele kube khona akutholayo uma bedivosa ngoba babehlanganise amafa. Inkantolo inqume ukuthi imindeni ibonisane ngalolu daba.UNksz Vilakazi uthe umnakwabo ugcine evuma ukuthi angcwabe ngesonto eledlule wabuye wajika.“Sigcinana naye enkantolo wathi kulungile ngingcwabe, ngenza namalungiselelo okungcwaba ngeSonto. Kuthe sengiyolanda isidumbu ngoMgqibelo odlule ngathola enye incwadi yasenkantolo ethi ngingangcwabi,” kusho yena.Uthe bekumele baphindele bonke enkantolo ngoMsombuluko kodwa umnakwabo wangafika. Uveze ukuthi kufike amadoda abesonta nomufi, asabise ngokuthi uzophucwa ngisho umuzi ahlala kuwo.UNksz Vilakazi, ongumsebenzi wasezindlini, uthe uke wamzama ummeli ozimele waxakeka ngenxa yemali.Umnakwabo, uNksz Ncamsile Gamede (30), ucingo ulunikeze omunye wesifazane ochaphe intatheli ngenhlamba. Kuthe noma ebuzwa igama lakhe waqhubeka nenhlamba esabisa nangokuthi uzoyilungisa intatheli uma ike yakhipha udaba.Udadewabo kamufi, uNkk Mabaso, elingatholakala igama lakhe, ubhoke ngolaka wathi useganile, akafuni ukufakwa ezindabeni.Ummeli ozimele, uNksz Nolwazi Malimela, weNN and Associates, uthe kungenzeka ukuthi idivosi kaNksz Vilakazi yakhangiswa ephephandabeni ngoba kuyenzeka uma abantu bengasahlali ndawonye.Uthe uma umfundisi ebeseshadile akumele azixake ngokufuna isidumbu, kunalokho kumele ayofaka isicelo sokuthola ingxenye yamafa akhe ngoba babeshade umshado ohlanganisayo.

Ngaphambi kokuthi kusungulwe le nkampani, uMnyango wezeMpilo bewuwathenga eChina amakhondomu asatshalaliswa ezikhungweni zikahulumeni. Ngemuva kokuthi uhulumeni esungule uphiko oluyisipesheli lokuthuthukiswa komnotho, eDube Trade Port, uthathe isinqumo sokuthi le nkampani ibe kulesi sikhungo esenzelwe ukuthi kube lula ukuthi kuthunyelwe izimpahla kwamanye amazwe.UDkt Dhlomo uthe: “Ungqongqoshe kumjabulisile akubone kulesi sikhungo waze wethembisa ukuthi uzobuya maduze azosivula ngokusemthethweni. Kuzoba lula ukuthi athunyelwe ezikhungweni zezempilo kulesi sifundazwe,” usho kanje.Amakhondomu athathwa njengesivikeli esiphephile esingavikela ukukhulelwa okungadingekile nokudluliselana ngezifo socansi.Izibalo zezempilo kuleli zikhombisa ukuthi amantombazane aneminyaka ephakathi kuka-15 no-24 kunamathuba amaningi okuthi athole igciwane lengculazi nokuthi akhulelwe engahlelile. text: Mhleli: Ngiyabonga ngokungipha isikhala ephephandabeni lakho. Ake ngibonge yize ngingazi ukuthi abaholi be-ANC eThekwini bafinyelele kanjani esinqumeni abasithathile. Umphakathi waKwaZulu-Natal uyayithanda i-ANC kodwa izinto eziningi ezenziwa wuKhongolose kulesi sifundazwe zenza umphakathi ubone kungafanele uzihlanganise nale nhlangano.Ngifunde ephephandabeni kuthiwa ubuholi be-ANC esifundeni iTheku bufuna ukuxoxa namalungu kaKhongolose akhetha ukuzimela okhethweni ngo-2016. Ake ngilungise lapha, bonke abazimela abakaze bawushiye uKhongolose yizinkinga nenkohlakalo okwenziwa ubuholi besifundazwe nobeTheku ezadala umphakathi uvele uthi abazimele nangempela kwenzeka. Ngenzela ukucacisa lokho. Okunye okumele sikukhulume wukuthi umphakathi omningi waseThekwini owalinyazwa ngokufunzwa amakhansela abaholi besifunda seTheku awujabulile.Namanje umphakathi usadiniwe. Ukukhuluma nabazimela ngeke kwenze mahluko. Nikwenza lokhu ngoba senifuna amavoti noma seniwuqala kabusha umbutho?Uma nilungisa amaphutha kumele nibize wonke amaqabane enawona kuqala ngoba umphakathi wazi wona la maqabane nina buholi besifunda anaziwa emphakathini. Naziwa ngemisebenzi yenu emibi yokufunza umphakathi amakhansela uma nihluleke ukuzithoba emphakathini ivoti ngo-2019 nango-2021 lizoya emakhanseleni azozimela futhi.Inkinga enkulu esibhekene nayo wukuthola ubulungu be-ANC emagatsheni. Kuyaqala lokhu akukaze kwenzeke. Selokhu kwangena lobu buholi ubulungu asibutholi. UNobhala wesifunda seTheku uMnuz Bheki Ntuli usikhomba konobhala emagatsheni. Njengoba onobhala kuyizingane zamakhansela sizobuthola kanjani ubulungu ngoba phela lezi zingane zivikela isinkwa zona ngobulungu? Kungani kumele kuthiwa asiye ehlathini sibhekile?Usho kanjani ukuthi angiye kumuntu ozohlezi engatholakali kodwa ngobusuku unikeza omama abathize ukuthi abayojoyinisa labo ababanike imixhaso kuphela? Miningi imikhuba ebuholini besifunda ngoba bunesandla kule nto eyenzeka. Uma beshayelwa izingcingo sengathi kabazi ngale nkinga kodwa emakhoneni bayahlangana nalaba bantu ababulala umbutho.Siwutholile umyalezo wokuthi emagatsheni aseThekwini wonke ngenyanga edlule bekujoyiniswa ubulungu. Umbuzo wami uthi ngaphambi kwalokho senihlanganile yini namaqabane wonke ama-ward nawachazela ngomyalezo? Njengoba sizokhipha imali yethu sizothemba kanjani ukuthi izokhokhelwa ngoba kade sasigileka sikhokhe bese siyakhishwa uma sekukhethwa ubuholi. Ngizokwenza isibonelo njengaku-ward 78 eMlaza lapho ikhansela lingusihlalo bese kuthi indodakazi yekhansela ibe ngunobhala bese indoda yalo iba kwiBEC. Kuyona leyo BEC kunezalukazi zaku-ward 84 ezinikwe ubulungu ku-ward 78 yini ezolunga?Lolu hlelo lokujoyinisa umphakathi kungani ningalwenzi ngenye indlela? Kungaphela isonto ubufakazi bungabuyile bokuthi ukhokhile nezimfanelo zakhe azithole njengoba zinjalo njengoba kunamakhansela eThekwini axosha noma akhela ababengahambisani nawo amatulo okuthi baxoshwe emisebenzini, kusalungiswa nalapho? Njengoba amalungu ekomiti ye-ward enikezwe umyalelo wokuthi alandele abantu abasebenzayo njengezinduna, kusemthethweni yini lokho baholi be-ANC? Kusemthethweni yini ukuthi ubulungu bethu buhlale ezikhwameni zamakhansela?Sengizovala laba bantu enabalaxaza ngo-2016 yibona abazokwenza ukuthi nikwazi ukungena emphakathini uma ningaxoxanga nabo, khohlwani baholi amavoti. Siyawuthanda impela uKhongolose kodwa uma niqhubeka nale nto yenu amagatsha amaningi azohamba kodwa ithuba lisekhona ngoba akumnandi ukubona iqabane elidala elazabalaza lingenabo ubulungu.Esinye isilwane okumele nibhekane naso yilesi okuthiwa wuhlu lwabazovotelwa ebuholini. Okukhishwa abantu abathandwa wumphakathi kuyona. Unobhala omusha wayichaza kahle sayizwa ukuthi isuke yenziwelani. Asithembe ngeke isenzeka. Unobhala, uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli, sesithembe wena nomfo kaZikalala ukuthi nizokwazi ukubuyisela uKhongolose ebantwini ngoba eyi uthando emphakathini bese luphelile kodwa nje ukuxolisa ngokuwufunza abantu abangaziwa kuyonisiza bese niyaqinisekisa ukuthi ngokulandelayo ngeke nisawuphinda. Niyobe nisebenzile. Nginifisela inhlanhla, sengathi konke okuhle ebenikucabanga ngombutho kungalunga baholi.Zamani KheswaEThekwini

text: UMENGAMELI ngokuhlonishwa we-IFP inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi uthi kuyomphatha kabi uma eze washona lungaqediwe uhlelo lokubuyisana phakathi kweNkatha ne-ANC.Ekhuluma emcimbini wokwethulwa ngokusemthethweni kwesikhwama sakhe nomngani wakhe ongusomabhizinisi ohlonishwayo, uMnuz Harry Oppenheimer esikhumulweni sezindiza esidala ngaseSiphingo izolo, uButhelezi uthe inhliziyo yakhe kayikutholi ukuphumula ngokuthi lolu hlelo kalukaqedwa.“Kuyongiphatha kabi uma ngivala amehlo ami ngishona kodwa kusenezilonda ezingakalashwa phakathi kwe-IFP ne-ANC,” kusho uButhelezi.Uthe uyajabula ukuthi umholi ohlonishwayo we-ANC, uMnuz Meshack Radebe ukhona emcimbini wakhe.“Kuyintokozo ukuba khona kukaRadebe lapha owaziwa kakhulu ngamagalelo akhe okudala uxolo phakathi kwe-IFP ne-ANC eHammarsdale ebambisene noDkt Sipho Mlaba ongasekho. Ngisho nangesikhathi uRadebe enze umcimbi wokugubha ukuhlanganisa iminyaka engu-70, wangimema kwakhe eMaqongqo ngaya ngoba ngangazi ukuthi ukungimema kwakhe kwakugqugquzelwa yintshisekelo yakhe yokubona sibuyisana,” kusho uButhelezi.Uthe kade kwasa ethukwa, ebizwa ngawo wonke amagama ngabaholi be-ANC, abanye baze bambize ngomdayisi nangencelebane yabamhlophe.“Noma ngangihlaselwa ngayo yonke indlela kodwa bekungiqinisa kungenze ngime kulokhu engikholelwa kukho ngenxa yokwesekwa enganginikukwa ngumngani wami * -Oppenheimer, wangiseka futhi nangesikhathi ngithatha isinqumo sokunqaba ukuthi isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal sibe nguzimele geqe njengoba ezinye izifundazwe ezine zase zivumile,” kusho uButhelezi.Uthe ngenxa yozimele geqe, abantu abamnyama babenziwa abantu bokufika ezweni labo.“Njengoba ngilapha namhlanje emcimbini wokwethulwa kwalesi sikhwama sami nomngani wami ngizizwa sengathi ngisemngcwabeni wami uqobo,” kusho uButhelezi.Isikhulumi sosuku emcimbini, uMnuz John Kane-Berman, sigeqe amagula sichaza umlando kaButhelezi namagalelo akhe emzabalazweni.“Kuyiqiniso elifihliwe ukuthi uButhelezi nguyena owayephoqa uhulumeni wobandlululo ukuthi akhulule uMengameli wokuqala wentando yeningi kuleli uDkt Nelson Mandela ejele, uButhelezi waze wasabisa ngokuthi ngeke alungenele ukhetho uma uMandela engakhululwa, kuningi akwenza ukuze abamnyama bakhululeke kodwa kufihliwe,” kushouKane-Berman.Umeluleki kaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Linda Zama, uthe umlando wakuleli kawuphelele ngaphandle kukaButhelezi no-Oppenheimer.UNksz Zama uchaze uButhelezi njengomholi osezingeni lomhlaba ngenxa yamagalelo akhe emzabalazweni“Kakusilo ihaba ukuthi sithi uMntwana waKwaPhindangene uyingqalabutho yomholi wakuleli, osebenze cishe nabo bonke abaholi abahlonishwayo nabadumile hhayi lapha eNingizimu Afrika nasezwenikazi kodwa nasemhlabeni wonke uqobo,” kusho uNksz Zama.

Bheki Cele ngokufaka unyawo lwedada eThekwini.“UNtuli uyagxambukela eThekwini, lokho akusithusi ngoba vele umfowabo uMnuz Bheki Ntuli obenguNobhala eThekwini ukhona embangweni wezikhundla njengoba kuyiwa engqungqutheleni yesifunda, esinye isizathu esenza angabi qotho odabeni lwaseThekwini wukuthi uNkk Gumede wayehola ithimba laseThekwini elaliphikisana nokuthi akhethwe njengoNobhala wesifundazwe,” kusho uDube.Uthe kwabathusa futhi ukuthi ngesikhathi beboshiwe ngeledlule esiteshini samaphoyisa eDurban Central ngemuva kombhikisho, bezwa elinye iphoyisa lithi uthe uCele ufuna inombolo yecala.Omunye wabakhulumela abeseka uNkk Gumede, uMnuz Sduduzo Magwaza uthe uNobhala we-ANC esifundazweni, nomfowabo obenguNobhala waseThekwini baba nomhlangano nemenenja yoMkhandlu weTheku, ngoJuni 18, iMeya isinikwe ikhefu lenyanga.Omunye wabeseka imeya, uMnuz Ntando Khuzwayo, uthe: “Singabaholi thina emagatsheni nakuma-zone e-ANC konke lokhu esikwenzayo sikwenza ngoba singahambisani ukuthi kudlalwa ngalo.”UDube uthe: “Sesibhalele ubuholi bukazwelonke ukuba bungenele, uma singaneme ngokungenela kwabo sizophoqeleka ukuthi siye enkantolo.”Okunye okuvelile wukuthi abeseka uNkk Gumede Sihlangane nabo bonke abathintekayo savumelana ngokuthi kudingeka kuhlanganiswe leli komidi elizobhekana nalezi zinkinga, egqame kakhulu ileyo yoshintsho kule mboni yabangcwabi, nakho konke abakuvezile,” kusho uZikalala.AbeNafupa SA nabo sebeguqukile kulokhu abekade besabisa ngokukwenza, kokuvimba izinkampani zamaNdiya nabelungu ukuthi zingangeni emalokishini ukuzongcwaba, kusukela kule nyanga ezoqala.Leli komiti lihlanganisa izinhlangano ezahlukene okubalwa kuzo iSouth African Social Security Agency, uMnyango wezeMpilo, i-Road Accident Fund noMnyango wezaseKhaya.Leli komiti lizohlangana izikhathi eziningi libe selibikela uZikalala ngomgamo eseliwuhambile ekuxazululeni lezi zinkinga eziveziwe.

UMHOLI womphakathi oyisilomo, odume nangokutetemukisa izingane zendawo aziyise ebhishi, usolwa ngokudlwengula amantombazanyana ayisikhombisa. UMnuz Xolani Ngidi, oneminyaka ewu-40, kuthiwa ubedlwengula amantombazanyana aneminyaka esukela kwemine kuya ku-12 ngezindlela ezahlukene. Amanye kuthiwa ubewabiza, awagcobe uVaselina bese ewanukubeza.Ngokwabazali balezi zingane, umsolwa unguSihlalo weCommunity Policing Forum (CPF) emijondolo yaseManyaleni, e-Unit 2, eChatsworth ngaseThekwini.Kuthiwa uneloli elithutha udoti endaweni, abegibelisa kulona izingane, ebelenza ukuthi izingane zimthande ngoba ubehlale ezipha izinto ezimnandi.Lo msolwa uvele izolo eNkantolo yeMantshi eChatsworth.Umphakathi nabazali bebephume ngobuningi bezothamela icala, bebhikisha nangaphandle kwenkantolo.“Eyami ingane uqale ukuyidlwengula ikade yenza uGrade 1. Ngithole manje seyenza uGrade 3 ukuthi kade aqala ukuyidlwengula,” kusho omunye wabazali.Uthe izingane zabo ubezinunusela ngemali nangamamaswidi. Ngokusho kwabo, umsolwa ungumuntu ozimele kahle endaweni, yingakho izingane zabo bezithanda ukuyodlala nezingane zakwakhe.Bathe emzini kamsolwa kunezinto eziningi zokudlala izingane njengozwingi, amabhayisikili nokunye okuningi okuthandwa izingane.INGXENYE yomphakathi obutheleke eNkantolo yeMantshi eChatsworth eThekwini, uzobhikishela owesilisa osolwa ngokudlwengula izingane zamantombazane emijondolo yaseManyaleni endaweni:Isithombe TUMI PAKKIES“Besiyaye singanaki uma izingane zethu ziyodlala khona ngoba naye unezingane. Bezidlala ndawonye nezakhe kwakhe,” kuchaza omunye wabazali.Njengendoda emi kahle, kuthiwa umsolwa ubenganqeni ukulayisha izingane zomakhelwane azivakashise ebhishi ziyozijabulisana nezakhe.Bathe izingane zabo azisafuni nokuya esikoleni ngoba zihlekwa ngezinye, kwazise sekuyaziwa ukuthi kunezinsolo zokudlwengulwa wumsola.“Ezinye umchamo usuyaziphumela nje, azisakwazi ukuzibamba ngenxa yokudlwengulwa. Abanye babantwana bethu sebehlala bezinwaya amathanga sengathi banotwayi. Badlala le ndoda endala.”Abanye abazali bathe izingane zabo sezihlale zikhala uma kwenzeka zibuka ithelevishini ekhombisa izithombe zabantu ababambanayo ngoba kuba sengathi lokho kwenzeka kuzona.Nakuba abanye babo bethe izingane zabo zithola ukwelulekwa ngokomqondo njalo ngenyanga, abanye bathe ezabo kuselukhuni satshe ukuthola lokho ngoba abazi ukuthi kumele benze njani.

SIKHULU isililo ngokubulawa kwevolontiya le-ANC laseMfume ebeligqugquzela ukuvota.Kuthiwa uMnuz Nqobizwe Mkhize (46) waseSimahleni, eMfume uhlaselwe abalisa abangaziwa abathathu elele nomkakhe ezintatha kuzosa kube nguMgqibelo. Kuleya ndawo kuphinde kwabulawa abalisa ababili, uMnuz Sibonelo Hlongwane noMnuz Nathi Hlengwa abatholakale bedindilize emgwaqweni buqamama nalapho okuhlala khona uMkhize.Kuthiwa laba balisa bangene batshela umkakhe okhulelwe ukuthi akamboze angababuki base bedubula uMkhize kaningana. Kuthiwa izinhlamvu ezintathu zingene ekhanda.Okhulumela amaphoyisa uCaptain Nqobile Gwala uthe amaphoyisa aphenya amacala amathathu okubulala.“Kukholakala ukuthi kuthe uma kugamanxa ihora lesibili ekuseni kwatheleka abasolwa abathathu abebehlome ngezibhamu, bakhahlela isicabha bangena kwaMkhize bamdubula. Udubuleke amahlandla amaningi kwesingenhla. Isizathu sokubulawa kwakhe asikaziwa,” kusho uCaptain Gwala.Isigameko sesibili kukholakala ukuthi senzeke ngaphambi kwehora lesithathu lapho okuhlaselwe khona uHlongwane noHlengwa abadutshulwe abalisa abangaziwa abebehamba ngemoto. Lesi sigameko senzeke emuva kokubulawa kukaMkhize.UCaptain Gwala uthe laba balisa bashonele endaweni yesigameko. Uthe isizathu sokubulawa kwabo asikaziwa.Ikhansela lakuleya ndawo, uMnuz Ayanda Ndlovu, lichaze uMkhize njengomuntu obezinikele emsebenzini weqembu nasekusizeni umphakathi. Uthe nguye obenikwe umsebenzi wokugqugquzela abantu ukuthi babhalisele ukuvota.“Ubengumuntu obethandwa kakhulu wumphakathi. Silahlekelwe njengeqembu nomphakathi ngoba ubezinikele futhi esebenzisa ngisho imali yakhe ukwenza imisebenzi yeqembu. Kubuhlungu kakhulu okwenzekile. Sishaqekile nangokubulawa kukaHlongwane noHlengwa abatholakale befile. Sinxusa noma ubani ongaba nolwazi ukuthi asebenzisane namaphoyisa ukuze kutholakale izigilamkhuba,” kusho uNdlovu.UNdlovu uthe inkosikazi kaMkhize okulindeleke ukuthi ibelethe kule nyanga isesimeni esingesihle ngokomphefumulo ngenxa yokubulawa komyeni wayo ibhekile.UMxhumanisi wekomiti lesikhashana le-ANC KwaZulu-Natal Mnuz Sihle Zikalala uthe bashaqekile ngesigameko esenzeke kuleya ndawo. Uthe banethemba lokuthi amaphoyisa azosebenza kanzima ukuthola abathintakayo.Izolo uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele uye kuleya ndawo eyokhuluma nomphakathi. UCele uthembise amalungu omphakathi ukuthi amaphoyisa azophenya ngesigameko sokubulawa kwalaba bobathathu. Uqhube wathi amaphoyisa azophenya nangamacala osekunesikhathi engaphothulwa. Elinye lalamacala uthe ngelokubulawa kowayengunozinti wePirates neqembu lesizwe, uSenzo Meyiwa, elisahlalise kabuhlungu izihlobo zakhe nomphakathiwonkana.“Sicele umphakathi ukuthi usebenzisane namaphoyisa uphinde ubike amaphoyisa angenzi kahle kodwa uthi uwabika nawo ube ukhumbula ukuthi akhona amaphoyisa enza kahle nokufanele usebenzisane nawo,” kusho uCele.Uthe uxoxe nenkosi yendawo wathola ukuthi lesi sigameko kungenzeka ukuthi asihlobene nezepolitiki.Noma kunjalo uCele unxuse amaphoyisa ukuthi asebenze kanzima ukuthola abenzi bobubi ngisho kungathiwa abantu abaphezulu.

ABANTU besifazane basanenkinga yokuthola usizo oluphephile lokuhushula izisu njengoba namanje kusenesibalo esiphezulu sabesifazane abasahushula izisu ezikhungweni ezingagunyaziwe ukwenza lo msebenzi.Kukholakala ukuthi zilinganiselwa ku-260 000 izigameko zokuhushulwa kwezisu okuthiwa zenziwa ezikhungweni ezingekho emthethweni eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kusanda kuvela engqungqutheleni eyaziwa nge-Abortion and Reproductive Justice: The Unfinished Revolution III ebikuleli ebidingida izinkinga abahlangabezana nazo abantu besifazane uma bezama ukuyothola izinhlelo zokuhushula izisu nokunye.Umbiko we-Amnesty International wango-2017 usanda kuveza ukuthi yize sekuneminyaka engu-21 kwaphasiswa umthetho ovumela abesifazane ukuthi bazithathele bona isinqumo sokuhushula izisu kodwa ziseziningi izinkinga.Ngokusho kwalo mbiko, zingaphansi kuka-7% izikhungo zezempilo zikahulumeni ezihlinzeka ngezinhlelo zokuhushula izisu ezikhungweni ezingu-3 880.Lesi sibalo singaphansi kakhulu kunesibalo sezikhungo ezingu-505 uhulumeni ahlele ukuthi zenze lo msebenzi eNingizimu Afrika.Yize ukuhushulwa kwezisu kusemthethweni kuleli, kukholakala ukuthi izigameko eziphakathi kuka-52% kuya ku-58% zenziwa ezikhungweni ezingekho emthethweni.Ingqungquthela ebingesonto eledlule e-Eastern Cape, obekukhona kuyona abantu abalinganiselwa ku-285 basemazweni angu-26 emhlabeni wonke, ilandela eyayiseCanada ngo-2014.Imibiko yakamuva yoMnyango wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal ikuvezile ukuthi abantu besifazane bagcina benezinkinga ngenxa yokuhushula izisu ezikhungweni ezihushula izisu ngokungemthetho.Lokhu kugcina kuholele ekutheni abantu besifazane babe nezinkinga ezehlukene okubalwa kuzo ukulimala kwesibeletho, ukuphuphuma kwezisu nokunye.Umbiko wakuleli weSaving Mothers wango-2012 uveze ukuthi abantu besifazane abangu-186 abaphuphunyelwe yizisu balinyalelwa nayizibeletho ezikhugweni zikahulumeni.UMnuz Jacques van Zuydam, ongumqondisi jikelele wezokuthuthukiswa kwabantu kuMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi kuzwelonke uthe kubajabulisile ukuba yingxenye yengqungquthela. Lapha ngingabala oHulumeni waKwaZulu, Qwaqwa, Lebowa, KwaNdebele, Gazankulu, KwaNgwane ababengoZibuse bese kuba owaseTranskei, Ciskei, Venda naseBophuthatswana ababengoZimele Geqe.Mina nodadewethu ababili uNomonde, noNonceba nomfowethu osadlula emhlabeni uJabulani sizalwa ngumama onguMxhosa intombi yeHlubi yakwaXaba nobaba wethu uBaloyi esikhule sazi ukuthi ungumShangane.Abazali bethu bahlangana eMgungundlovu behlanganiswa umsebenzi bashada, kwazalwa thina. Sikhule elokishini eSobantu sihlala nabantu abangaMaZulu, safunda isiZulu saze saphothula isikole.Yize umama nobaba bebehlale bezikhuluma izilimi zabo isiXhosa nesiShangane/Tsonga uma kuvakashe izihlobo zethu kodwa alikho nelinye ilanga lapho sazibona khona ukuthi singamaShangane kuqala andube sibe ngaMaZulu.Abazali bethu basikhulise ngendlela yokuthi sizibone siyizakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika kuqala andube sizibone imvelaphi yethu engicabanga ukuthi yikho okwenza singazizwa sicwasekile ekukhuleni kwethu.Ngiyakhumbula ukuthi njalo ngeSonto odadewethu babethi uma bebuye esontweni bagqoke imvunulo yesiShangane, ebizwa ngokuthi umtsheko noma iShibhelani, banconywe uma behamba ngaphakathi elokishini abantu bencoma ubaba ngokuziqhenya kwakhe ngemvelaphi yakhe.Ekukhuleni kwami ngifunda ngizazi ukuthi ubuzwe bami ngiliShangane. UMENGAMELI we-IFP, inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi uxwayisa uhulumeni we-ANC ngokuthi kumele uluphathise okwezikhali zamaNtungwa udaba lokuthathwa komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo, ukugwema ukuthi izwe lingagcini selifana neZimbabwe.Ekhuluma emcimbini wokugubha uSuku lwamaLungelo aBantu eKing Zwelithini Stadium eMlaza izolo, uButhelezi uthe udaba lomhlaba lujulile akumele lusingathwe noma yikanjani.“Ngikhuluma nje abantu baseZimbabwe bagcwele lapha eNingizimu Afrika ngoba bebalekela ukuhlupheka okukhona ezweni labo kusukela kwathathwa umhlaba kwabamhlophe.Nathi vele siyazihluphekela njengoba iningi lisaphila ngaphansi kwendlala. Umbuzo wami uthi sifuna ukuhlupheka phezu kwalokho esinakho?” Kubuza uButhelezi.Uthe umnotho waseZimbabwe ubuqinile ulandela owaseNingizimu Afrika kodwa manje usudonsa kanzima.“Obengumengameli waseZimbabwe, uMnuz Robert Mugabe ulibulele izwe lakhe ngokusingatha budlabha udaba lokuthathwa komhlaba. Kuhle ngoba leli zwe lingomakhelwane bethu. Kumele ngabe kukhona esikufundile khona,” kusho uButhelezi.Uthe bayamuzwa uMengameli we-ANC uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa ethi umhlaba uzothathwa kodwa kumele kwenziwe isiqiniseko sokuthi umkhiqizo wokudla awuphazamiseki.“Sithule silindele ukubona ukuthi kuzokwenzakani,” kusho uButhelezi.Uthe i-IFP ayikanqumi ukuthi imi kuphi odabeni lokuthathwa komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo.Njengoba uqina umkhankaso we-ANC wokuthi kubuyiswe umhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo, sekukhona amazwe asentshonalanga asesabise ngokuthi azolinswinywa leli uma like lawuqhuba lo mkhankaso.Uphinde waxwayiswa ngesiphakamiso sokuthi kufakwe izimayini nokunye ngaphansi kukahulumeni.“Thina sikhulele khona kwi-ANC. Into ebikhulunywa wukuthi kufakwe izinto ngaphansi kukahulumeni. Nami ngaze ngahamba ngayohlangana nowayengumengameli waseTanzania ongasekho, uMnuz Julius Nyerere okunguye owayethathwa njengobaba wase-Afrika, ephusha indaba yokufakwa kwezinto ngaphansi kukahulumeni. Yena futhi uNyerere wabuye washintsha wasixwayisa ngokuthi udaba lokufaka izinto ngaphansi kukahulumeni lulibulele izwe lakhe,” kusho uButhelezi.Uthe ngesikhathi umholi we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema efike kuyena ezoxolisa ngemuva kokumdelela, wamxwayisa ngodaba lokufakwa kwezimayini ngaphansi kukahulumeni.“Kuyabokalala ukuthi uMalema akazange angilalele njengoba esaqhubeka nalolu daba. Kodwa isisho sesiZulu siyasho ukuthi isalakutshelwa sibona ngomopho,” kusho uButhelezi.Uphinde wasola uMalema ngokukhomba ngomunwe isihlalo seSilo Samabandla uGoodwill Zwelithini, ngokuthi athi akuthathwe kungaphansi kwaso.Uthe inkulumo kaMalema ethi iSilo akumele sisatshwe kodwa kumele sihlonishwe, ayizange yehle kahle.“Kade kwasa ngithukwa ngodaba lomhlaba. Ukuba izinhlamba ziyahlala ebusweni ngabe angisabonakali,” kusho uButhelezi. Wengeze ngokuthi wathatha isinqumo sokuthi achibiyele umthetho iNgonyama Trust ngo-1994 ngoba wayefuna ukuvikela amanenjana omhlaba ayesesele kowase uthathwe ngabamhlophe.UButhelezi uphinde wakhala ngokuthi yize leli selibe ngaphansi kwentando yeningi iminyaka engu-24 kodwa iningi labantu lisaphila ngaphansi kobubha.Uthe isikhumbuzo somgubho wamalungelo abasikhumbuli ngokuzila kodwa ngokuqinisekisa ekuvikelwa kwamalungelo abantu.

SIZOVULWA ngelizayo isikole iSahlumbe High, eWeenen osekuphele inyanga sivaliwe ngenxa yezimpi zezigodi zabafundi ezikapakele esikoleni.Kuthiwa nezidakamizwa zidliwa udede esikoleni kukhalwa nangokushoda kwamakilasi.Izolo uNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo uMnuz Kwazi Mshengu ube nomhlangano nomphakathi wakule ndawo kubalwa nenkosi uMthembu lapho kuvunyelwene khona ngokuthi kumele sivulwe isikole.Okhulumela uMshengu, uMnuz Kwazi Mthethwa, uthe kuvunyelwene nomphakathi nazo zonke ezinye izinhlaka ukuthi lesi sikole kumele sivulwe uma sekuvulwa izikole ngoLwesibili oluzayo.Uthe bekungokwesibili bebuyela kulesi sikole enyangeni eyodwa.“Ungqongqoshe uzimisele ngokuthi kulungiswe isimo sesikole yingakho ebuyele kaningi kusona ezama ukuthi kutholakale isixazululo. Ziningi izinto ebezinomthelela wokuthi kuphazamiseke isikole njengokuthi izimpi zezigodi zikapakele esikoleni, kube nokukhala kubazali ngendaba yezinguquko ngohlelo lwezemfundo kanjalo namagumbi angomahamba nendlwana okufundela okusho ukuthi ayashoda ngakho kudinga ukuthi sakhiwe isikole,” kusho uMthethwa.Uthe kuvunyelwene ngokuthi kubanjiswane wathi nendaba yengqalasizinda izolungiswa.UMshengu unxuse umphakathi ukuthi izikole uziphathise okwamagugu ngoba yilapho kwakhiwa khona abantu abazoba wutho ngomuso.Uthe kube nesikhalo ngokuthi isikole asilawuleki kahle ngoba abafundi baningi.“Bese sisezinhlelweni zokuthi sakhe esinye isikole eSahlumbe ukuze sikwazi ukuthatha omunye umthamo wabafundi bafundele khona. Kube nesikhalo ngendaba yezidakamizwa okuthiwa ziba nomthelela ekutheni baxabane balwe.”Uthe kube nesikhalo ngokusebenza kothisha njengoba abazali bethi abazange abafundi bawathole amaripoti kuvalwa izikole.Kumele kwenziwe umsebenzi, uthisha kumele afundise cishe amahora ayisikhombisa ngosuku. KUMISIWE ukufunda okwesikhashana esikoleni eBunguni Secondary kulandela ukuvuka umbhejazane kwabafundi, bashisa isikole bekhala ngokungabibikho kokudla.Izolo akuzange kufundwe kulesi sikole esiseNkanini, eMuden ngaphandle kwaseGreytown, emuva kwesigameko sangoMsombuluko lapho abafundi beqale bashaya khona othisha ngamatshe, baphihliza nezimoto zabo. Kuthiwa othisha baphume sebephelezelwa amaphoyisa. Abafundi basale baphihliza wonke amawindi esikole basokhela ngomlilo sasha sangqongqa.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi lokhu kwenzeke emuva kwesonto abafundi bebhale incwadi bebuza uthishanhloko ukuthi “balamba kangaka ikhona yini inkinga?” Kuthiwa bebefuna izimpendulo ukuthi kungani begcine ukudla ngoMeyi 15 nonyaka. Sekuphele amasonto amathathu kungadliwa namanzi engabonwa.Uthishanhloko kuthiwa wabhala incwadi wayihlohla eMnyangweni wezeMfundo nophakela lesi sikole ukudla emuva kwesikhalo sabafundi.NgoMsombuluko kuthiwa kuqale ngokujwayelekile ukufunda esikoleni kodwa kwathi sekuyisikhathi setiye abafundi bangabuyela emakilasini, kuthiwa yilapho beqale khona ukudedela amatshe bewabhekise kothisha.Othisha kuthiwa babaleke bangena endlini yabo yokuhlangana, amatshe elokhu ebalandela.Kubizwe amaphoyisa nabanye abazali ukuba bazolamula.Othisha bakhishwe amaphoyisa, babaleka.Abazali bafikile esikoleni bezolamula kodwa kwanhlanga zimuka nomoya njengoba abafundi bevele bokhela isikole ngomlilo besebenzisa amafutha.USihlalo wesigungu esilawula isikole uMnuz Ndoda Manyoni ethintwa izolo, uthe badumele ngalesi sigameko ngoba izingane zabo zizophazamiseka ezifundweni.“Kunzima nokuba ngikhulume ngalento njengoba isikole sishe saphela. Wonke amawindi esikole abulewe, kushe amagumbi okufunda, ihhovisi, indawo egcina impahla yesikole. Esikutholile ukuthi abafundi abazange besabuyela emakilasini beshaya othisha ngamatshe, kubizwe amaphoyisa, bagcina ngokushisa isikole. Asazi noma abafundi noma imidlwembe enza lento. Esikwaziyo ukuthi abafundi bakhala ngendaba yokungabi bikho kokudla namanzi esikoleni. Uthishanhloko ubesalulungisa udaba,” kusho uManyoni.Uthe okubaphatha kabi ukuthi abazi ukufunda kuzoqhubeka nini.“Nginezingane ezintathu kulesi sikole, efunda uGrade 12, 11 no-9. Angazi ngizokwenzenjani uma kuvalwa isikole, izingane ngizozilusisa izinkomo yini njengoba singenayo imali yokuziyisa kwezinye izikole. Namhlanje (izolo) bekumele kubhalwe izivivinyo zika-matric wangonyaka odlule kodwa akwenzekanga njengoba isikole sishisiwe. Kunomhlangano ebesinawo othisha bafike begadwe amaphoyisa ngoba besaba. Akufundwa nje esikoleni, asazi koze kufundwe nini ngoba isikole simoshwe saphela,” kusho uManyoni.Emuva komhlangano wayizolo kuphume umbono womhlangano ophuthumayo nokulindeleke ukuba uhanjelwe ubuholi bendawo okubalwa nenkosi.Lo mhlangano uhlelelwe uLwesihlanu ekuseni.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Kwazi Mthethwa uthe bayalwazi loludaba futhi benza konke okusemandleni ukuba isimo sibuyele kwesijwayelekile bese kuyafundwa. text: ZINGASE zivalwe ezinye zezikole okuvalwe ngehlahla kwangaphasa ngisho umfundi oyedwa ku-matric KwaZulu-Natal ngo-2018 ngoba ezinye zazo bezinomfundi oyedwa obhalile.UMnyango wezeMfundo esifundazweni uzobizela esigcawini othishanhloko balezi zikole ukuthi bazochaza ngemiphumela engemihle abayitholile. Sinyukile isibalo sezikole okungaphasanga muntu kuzona ngo-2018 njengoba ziyisishiyagalolunye zisuka kwezintathu ngo-2017.Okhulumela umnyango uMnuz Sihle Mlotshwa, uthe bazobiza nothishanhloko bezikole ezithole ngaphansi kuka-60% ukuze kucutshungulwe imiphumela yalezi zikole. Uthe kulezi eziyisishiyagalolunye ezithole u-0% asikho esango-2017 okwakungaphasanga muntu kusona, yizikole ezintsha.“Lezi ezintathu ezazithole u-0% azikho kulezi eziyisishiyagalolunye zangonyaka odlule okungaphasanga muntu kuzona. Ezinye zalezi ezithole u-0% bezinesibalo esincane sabafundi ababhalile njengoba kwesinye ubeyedwa kwesinye bebane. Abazali kumele babambisane nathi uma sifuna ukuvala isikole ngoba ezinye zezingqinamba uma sifuna ukuhlanganisa izikole noma sivale ezinye ngukuthi abazali bayanqaba,” kusho uMlotshwa. Uthe basuke befuna ukuzivala ngoba basuke sebenze ucwaningo olunzulu wathi abamane nje bavuke sebevala isikole.“Nakulezi kukhona okubonakalayo ukuthi azisebenzi ngakho kudingeka ukuthi zivalwe, zihlanganiswe nezinye kodwa sizoxoxa nemiphakathi ethintekayo. Sizokwakha uhlelo lokuphucula imiphumela yalezi zikole ngoba sifuna ukuqeda ngezikole ezithola ngaphansi kuka-0%.”UNgqongqoshe walo mnyango, uMnuz Mthandeni Dlungwane, wayethe ufuna ukuqeda ngezikole ezithola u-0% kulesi sifundazwe. Zingu-12 ezweni lonke izikole okungaphasanga muntu kuzona ngo-2018.Esinye sazo yiMpikayizekanye Secondary ebinabafundi abangu-18. Lesi sikole sike sangena ehlazweni lokukopela kwabafundi ngo-2014. Umnyango waqinisa kakhulu ezikoleni ezathinteka ekukopeleni kwabafundi ngokuthi kube nabantu abazozinza kuzona kuze kuqala ukubhala kwezivivinyo zize ziphothulwe.Ezinye zezikole ezithinteka ekukopeleni kubalwa iMaweni High, Mzoniwe High okubhale kuyo abayisishiyagalombili, Ncwecwe Secondary okubhale abafundi ababili, Nende Secondary okubhale abafundi abangu-10, Sbonginhlanhla Secondary okubhale umfundi oyedwa, Groenvlei Combined okubhale abafundi abayisishiyagalombili, Vuleka School for the Deaf okubhale abane naKwaMpunzi Combined okubhale abafundi abayisikhombisa.

BASHAQEKILE abasebenzi bakaMasipala wasoLundi emuva kokuthi indoda eqapha izikhulu zomkhandlu idubule uzakwabo obesebenza kwizicishamlilo wafa endaweni yokucima ukoma ngeSonto.Indoda (35), engeke ize idalulwe ngoba ayikabuzwa ukuthi iyalivuma noma iyaliphika yini icala, izolo bekulindeleke ivele eNkantolo yeMantshi yasoLundi mayelana necala lokubulala uMnuz Phakamani Bukhosini (27).Kuthiwa kube nokulizisana phakathi kokuthiwa udubulile nomufi endaweni yokucima ukoma. Lokhu kuholele ekutheni adonse isibhamu adubule umufi kaningana.Isolezwe lithole ngomthombo walo ukuthi umufi uqale wadutshulwa onyaweni, wabe eseyaxolisa, ecela ukuthi angabulawa.Kuthiwa ilapho emdubule khona amahlandla amaningi, waze wasondela eduze ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi usefile.Omunye umthombo ongaphakathi kumasipala uthe umdubuli ubengasasiphathi isibhamu somsebenzi ngenxa yokuba nodlame ekhaya.“Usebenzise isibhamu sakhe okungesona esomsebenzi. Ubaziwa ukuthi unesandla esilula, uma eke waxabana nomuntu uvele asikhiphe, noma adubule.“Unolaka olumangalisayo. Yingakho ubengasanikezwa isibhamu somsebenzi,” kusho umthombo ocele ukungadalulwa.Imenenja yoMkhandlu wasoLundi, uMntwana Nkosenye Zulu, uthe abasebenzi bashaqekile ngokwenzekile.“Sikhungathekile njengomkhandlu nabasebenzi emveni kokuthi sithole izindaba ezithi omunye wabasebenzi bethu ongumqaphi udubule omunye umsebenzi wethu obesebenza kwizicishamlilo wambulala,” kusho uZulu.Uthe bezwe kuthiwa kube nokuhilizisana okuthile phakathi kwabasenzi babo nokugcine ngokuthi kudutshulwe.“Umufi obesebenza kwizicishamlilo ubelindele ukubizwa emsebenzini noma yinini. Umsolwa ubengasebenzi besendaweni yokuzithokozisa babe sebeyaxabana. Asazi ukuthi kubangweni kwagcina ngokuthi lona ongumqaphi adubule abulale lona obeyisicishamlilo,” kusho uZulu.Uthe namhlanje (izolo) bekungasebenzeki kubasebenzi baze babiza izinceku ukuba zizokhuleka.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uBrigader Jay Naicker, uthe indoda (35) ivele eNkantolo yeMantshi yasoLundi namhlanje (izolo) mayelana necala lokubulala.“Kuyasoleka ukuthi ngoNovemba 3, indoda (27) idutshulwe yashona emgwaqweni uBhambatha e-Unit B oLundi. Umufi ubenamanxeba amaningi okudutshulwa, kuvulwe icala lokubulala esiteshini samaphoyisa oLundi ukuze kuphenywe,” kusho uNaicker.

UNGOTI wezemfundo owaziwayo ngokugxeka uhulumeni angahlonizi ngokuhluleka ukufukula imfundo yakuleli uSolwazi Jonathan Jansen uthi uma uhulumeni ungase ugxile kakhulu emazingeni aphansi ezemfundo ngeke ibe khona inkinga yezinkumbi zabafundi abashiya phakathi ukufunda bengafinyelelanga kwa-matric.UJansen ozinze eNyuvesi yaseStellenbosch oke waba ngumphathi weNyuvesi yaseFree State, ukhwele wadilika kuhulumeni ngokuthi akayikhathalele imfundo ngoba izingane zosopolitiki zifunda ezikoleni ezingcono.“Ukuze uhulumeni alungise inkinga yezemfundo kuleli, kumele kugxilwe emazingeni aphansi ikakhulu ezinkulisa (Grade R). Akungagxilwa emazingeni aphezulu ikakhulu emanyuvesi,” kusho uJansen ekhuluma engqungqutheleni yenyunyana yothisha iNaptosa eThekwini ngoLwesihlanu.Uthe izinto zimapeketwane kwezemfundo yingakho abafundi abawuhhafu wesigidi bengafinyeleli kwa-matric beshiya phakathi izifundo.Usho lokhu nje izinyunyana zothisha zihlale zikhala ngokuthi kumele kuqiniswe emazingeni aphansi ikakhulu uGrade R njengoba othisha bakhona bengaqashiwe ngokugcwele. Imfundo ethathwa njengebalulekile iqala kwaGrade 1.Uthe kukhulu ukwehlukana kwezemfundo njengoba izingane zabacebile zithola engcono.Unxuse othisha ukuthi bangalindeli uhulumeni ukuthi afukule imfundo kodwa babhukule bazenzele.“Ningalindeli uhulumeni ngoba ayikho into azoyenza ngoba izingane zongqongqoshe zifunda ezikoleni ezikahle. Sukumani nenzele izingane zabahlwempu ezidonsa kanzima.”Ukhale kakhulu ngenye yezinyunyana angayidalulanga ukuthi uma iteleka ayifuni kuvalwe izikole zabamhlophe ngoba yilapho kufunda khona izingane zamalungu ayo.Uthe ucwaningo luyaveza ukuthi umfundi ofunde esikoleni esinayo yonke into, noma lezo ezazaziwa njengazabamhlophe kuba negebe uma umqhathanisa nalabo abafunde ezikoleni zabamnyama wathi leli gebe alibe lisavaleka kuze kuphele iminyaka engu-12 yokufunda.Ugqugquzele ukuthi kufundelwe abafundi nezingane izincwadi wancoma nothisha bokufika ukuthi bayawazi umsebenzi wabo.UMnuz Basil Manuel, isikhulu seNaptosa sikhale kakhulu ngokuthi kunenkinga kwiMaths njengoba abafundi beyifeyila.Uthe izinga lokuphasa lesi sifundo liphansi wathi noma bedlulela kwamanye amabanga aphezulu isimo siba sibi kakhulu.UNksz Thirona Moodley, isikhulu sale nyunyana kulesi sifundazwe, uxwayise othisha ukuthi bangabacwasi abafundi noma bafake imizwa yabo uma befundisa.Ukhulume ngesehlakalo sikathisha osulile waseWestville Girls High, osolwa ngokubiza abafundi abamnyama ngegama lokubacwasa eliqala ngo-K.
Siqinise imithethonqubo kaMgcinimafa, sakha isikhungo i-fusion centre futhi sanikeza uPhiko Olukhe-thekile Lwezokuphenya igunya elibanzi lokuphenya zonke izinsolo zenkohlakalo ezihlobene ne-COVID-19.
Umndeni nabangani bange seka abafundi ngokuzwelana nabo, ngokubagqugquzela nokubaqinisekisa njalo-nje, kusho uTlhapane.
Njengoba izwe libungaza Inyanga Yentsha, iVuk’uze nzele ibukisisa ukuthi intsha yezwe ihlinzekwa kanjani ngamathuba nguMnyango wezeMfundo ePhakeme Nezokuqeqesha ukuze i phumelele.

UJali kuthiwa uhlaselwe ngamadoda amabili angaziwa esemzini wakhe ntambama, avulele ngenhlamvu ebhekise kuye, washonela khona lapho.UDkt Siphiwe Vumase isikhulu esiphezulu esibhedlela iManguzi, uthe balahlekelwe kakhulu ngokushona kukaNkk Manzini obesesebenze iminyaka ewu-30 kulesi sibhedlela.“Ubefundisa abanye abahlengikazi lapha eMkhanyakude.
