IYASHUBA eyeziteleka emanyuvesi aKwaZulu-Natal njengoba izolo kuphazamiseke ukubhalisa eDurban University of Technology (DUT) nase-University of South Africa (Unisa) abasebenzi betelekela ukunyuselwa amaholo. Abasebenzi base-Unisa abangaphansi kweNational Education Health and Allied Workers Union (Nehawu) bafuna ukunyuselwa umholo ngo-12% kulo nyaka, umqashi uthi angabanika u-6%, abaseDUT bafuna u-10% umqashi uthi angabanika * -4%.Izinyunyana zabasebenzi baseDUT abangaphansi kweNehawu, iTertiary Education National Union SA (Tenusa) neNational Tertiary Education Union (NTEU) bangenele isiteleka ngoMsombuluko.Ngalolu suku bavule ngemashi ebiqondiswe koyiPhini likaShansela wale nyuvesi, uSolwazi Thandwa Mthembu.Izolo, abasebenzi abebethi babona sengathi umphathi uyabaziba babuyele ehhovisi lakhe befuna ukukhuluma naye.UMnuz Milton Estrice okhulumela lezi zinyunyana uthe kusukela bahambisa uhlu lwezikhalo ngalolu suku kuMthembu akukaze kube khona mpendulo noma umhlangano ohleliwe phakathi kwezinyunyana nomqashi.“Sibona sengathi iphini likaShansela lizishaya indiva izikhalo zethu kungakho namhlanje (izolo) sithe asibuye size ehhovisi lakhe ukuze asichazele ukuthi umi kuphi nodaba lwethu.“Sidinga isixazululo esisheshayo ngalolu daba ngoba sibona sengathi akazimisele ukululungisa,” kusho yena.Abasebenzi bazithele phezu konogada abebevimbile ehhovisi lomphathi, abasebenza kuleli hhovisi abathe akekho.ABASEBENZI baseDurban University of Technology (DUT) abatelekele ukwenyuselwa umholo izolo bemasha belibangise kumphathi wale nyuvesi, uSolwazi Thandwa Mthembu Isithombe: DOCTOR NGCOBOBathi uthe uzothumela umyalezo nge-email mayelana nomhlangano wokucacisango-4% no-6% umqashi azimisele ukunyusela ngayo abasebenzi.“Thina asiwazi u-6% ngoba sazi ukuthi abasebenzi abaqashwanga ngaphansi kohlelo olwaziwa nge-cost to company, yingakho sitshele abezindaba ukuthi umqashi ufuna ukubenyusela umholo ngo-4%. Sisamile ekutheni ngeke sibuyele emsebenzini lungalungisiwe lolu daba,” kusho yena.Lesi sikhungo siqashe abasebenzi besikhashana abebesebenzela kwenye ingxenye yenyuvesi abebebhalisa abafundi.UNksz Noxolo Memela oyimenenja yezokuxhumana kule nyuvesi, uthe inyuvesi izimisele ukulungisa lesi simo ngokushesha.Uthe abaphathi bazimisele ukuhlangana nezinyunyana kuleli sonto ukuze kuxazululwe udaba lwamaholo, olwaqala ukudingidwa ngoMeyi nyakenye.“Izitshudeni nabanye abantu abangena enyuvesi baphephile,” kusho yena.Khonamanjalo e-Unisa, abasebenzi abangaphansi kweNehawu bamise ukubhalisa befuna ukunyuselwa amaholo ngo-12%.Okhulumela iNehawu, uMnuz Khaya Xaba, uthe umqashi ufuna ukunyusa amaholo ngo-6% wathi bakhathele ukuthathwa kancane ngabakule nyuvesi.“Sifuna kuqashwe ngokugcwele abasebenzi abayitoho kuyekwe ukuxhashazwa kwabo emnyangweni wezobuchwepheshe.“Siyazi inyuvesi ingakwazi ukunyusela abasebenzi umholo ngoba babalelwa ku-400 000 abafundi ababhaliswayo minyaka yonke kanti kunoR400 billion osezinqolobaneni. Sizoteleka baze bahlangabezane nezimfuno zethu.”Imizamo yokuthola okhulumela le nyuvesi uMnuz Matrin Ramotshela ayiphumelelanga, ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa nemibuzo athunyelwe yona akayiphendulanga.

text: ABAMHLOPHE bafika ezwenikazi i-Afrika bathola abamnyama benamasiko abo. Nakuba babaphuca okuningi kodwa kukhona abangabanga namandla okubaphuca khona. Kokunye abangakwazanga ukukuphuca khona abampisholo yilo isiko nesintu sabo. Bafaka inkolo ngenhloso yokumdunga umqondo umuntu omnyama. Kuyadabukisa ukuthi kuthe uma sekuphatha umuntu omnyama, waphuca umuntu wakubo isiko nesintu sakhe. Namhlanje sinobugcwelegcwele izwelonke uhulumeni wakha imali ngabo, namhlanje sinezingane ezihlala emigwaqweni ezijika zibe yizigebengu, ezigcina sezibizwa ngamaphara.Ngo-1996 kwaqhanyukwa noMthethosisekelo wezwe owanconywa kwathiwa muhle kunayo yonke emhlabeni. Lihle iqiniso, lokho kwaba yingcwaba lokugcina kumuntu omnyama. Umuntu omnyama kuqale lapho ukuthi kuthiwe akenze izinto eziphambene nesiko nesintu sakhe, okugcine kumngcwaba okokugcina.Uma ingane izalwa emandulo bekwaziwa ukuthi uma uyise nonina bengashadile leyo ngane ingumlanjwana, iyohlale ingeyakoninalume. Namhlanje uma ingane izalwa esibhedlela akubuzwa nakubuzwa kuvele kuthiwe ayibhalwe ngesibongo sikayise, lawo maphepha ayogcina eseMnyangweni wezaseKhaya, nakhona ingane igxivizwe ngesibongo sikayise. Unina ngokungazi isiko njengalokhu selamuka nezinkolo avume kugcine isibongo esisebenzayo kungesikayise wengane. Uma makhathaleni ingane isinezinkinga, kugcina sekufanele kuhlehlelwe emuva ingane ilungise iphutha elenzeka ngesikhathi izalwa sekuthiwa ayihambe iyofuna izincwadi ezifungelwe kokunye kuthathwe igazi. Uma uyise wengane nonina sebexabana kuqala inkinga. Akubhekwa ukuthi iphutha leli elenzeka emuva esibhedlela, lilungiswe kalula ngoba kwaziwa ukuthi isiko nesintu kuthini.Namhlanje la maphara esikhala ngawo amaqanda azalwe nguMthethosisekelo wethu owakhiwe omnyama kubusa omnyama, amachwane achanyiselwa yilokhu kuhlupheka esikubona kubhebhetheka imihla namalanga enganeni yomuntu omnyama. Siqamba amanga sithi kunezinkumbi zezingane ezingayitholi imisebenzi ngoba sifuna ukwanelisa izifiso zepolitiki sibe sazi kahle kamhlophe ukuthi akulula ukuthola umsebenzi kuphambene esibongweni. Uma ingane iphuma iyofuna umsebenzi iphuma naliphi ithongo? Lokhu ongqongqoshe abaphethe kowezaseKhaya bakwazi kahle kamhlophe, ezabo izingane ngeke bavume ukuthi zibizwe ngesibongo abaziyo ukuthi akusona. Kufana ncamashi nokuthi ezemindeni yabo ezakhona izingane bazifaka ezibhedlela ezingcono, nasezikoleni ezingcono bese bethi bahola umphakathi wona oyiswa ezikoleni nasezibhedlela abathi ezikahulumeni. Liphi iqiniso eliyophephisa lisindise liphinde liphilise umuntu omnyama oholwa omnyama na?Namhlanje sekuyinsakavukela umchilo wesidwaba ukuthi yonke ingane ezalwayo uyise nonina abashadile, noma beshadile kodwa akuzange kwagcagcwa njengalokhu sekwalahleka isintu namasiko. Namhlanje sekuyinto enzima ukuthi uma uganwa ungaganwa umuntu ongenayo ingane. Iningi labesifazane linezingane, kanjalo nebesilisa.Ukuyeka imikhuba efana nokusoma nokuhlolwa kwabesimame nokufundiswa kwabafana entabeni yikhona okuchamisele le nkinga yokuthi wonke umuntu usethatha isinqumo sokuganwa enomuntu onengane yomunye. Kukabili-ke le ngane ayithole engakashadi owesimame uzohamba nayo uyoyibiza ngesibongo salapho eganele khona, kokunye uzwe bona abadala obathembile okuthi bazi isintu abazizalukazi namakhehla bethi hamba uyobiza isibongo sakini khona ungayohlupheka. Kulapho-ke kuqala khona izinkinga. Kulapho uqala khona ukuba nezinkinga zasemsamo usuhlangabezana nale nkinga yaseMnyangweni wezaseKhaya, sekuthiwa thola izincwadi ezifungelwe, kumbe kuthathwe igazi ukuthola ukuthi bayakuzala ngempela yini laba bantu ngoba uthi uzama ukuguqula isibongo kube ngesilungile.Abantu abaningi abaya kohlola ezangomeni namhlanje bazi kahle kamhlophe ukuthi yisibongo esonakele. Uyozwa nohlolayo ethi thatha isibongo sikayihlo into engelona nakancane isiko, belekelelwa amanye amabandla akhona athi ancike esintwini kodwa ebe ekhuthaza into ephambene nesintu.Lithi-ke elami uma uhulumeni engakalungisi ezibhedlela lapho kuzalelwa khona izingane kanjalo nasemnyangweni, abantu bakithi abathi beyokulungisa batshelwe lokhu nalokhu, usekude umuntu omnyama ukukhulukeka nokuthi umnotho ube sezandleni zakhe.NANSI INDABANgeke ulahlwe abezizwe, uyolahla abakini.Bhedlindaba(033) 5691317/ 0797471911/ 0728972001.

Lawo esiwabambayo siyawaxosha embuthweni, siwabeke namacala ayobhadla ejele,” kusho uSitole.Uthe kunoLt- General abathathu ababaxoshile ngoba bebethinteka ezehlakalweni zenkohlakalo.“Siyaluseka futhi uphenyo olwenziwa wuphiko oluphenya amaphoyisa, i-Independent Police Investigative Directorate (IPID).Yize luqhuba uphenyo lwalo nathi siyaqhubeka nophenyo lwethu lwangaphakathi,” kusho uSitole.Ephendula mayelana nophenyo olwenziwa yithimba eliphenya ngokubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal, uCele uvumile ukuthi umsebenzi waleli thimba awujabulisi.Uthe emacaleni cishe awu-40 okubulala mhlawumbe bane abantu ababoshiwe ngawo.“UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa wajuba oNgqongqoshe abaphethe izinhlaka zezokuphepha ukuthi bahlanganise amakhanda ukuze balwe nendaba yokubulawa kwabantu eKZN. Ngingasho ukuthi sesiwuhambisile umbiko wethu wokuqala kuMengameli. Ngingakuveza ukuthi akajabule ngokuphelele ngokwenziwayo,” kusho uCele.UMqondisi we-Institute for Security Studies, uSolwazi Johan Burger, ekhuluma nabakwa-eNCA ngemuva kwesithangami sabezindaba sikaCele noSitole, uthe bese belinde isikhathi eside ukuzwa ukuthi iziphathimandla zamaphoyisa zinaziphi izinhlelo zokulwa nobugebengu.UBurger uthe bayakwamukela ukutshalwa kwenqwaba yamaphoyisa emgwaqweni, wengeza ngokuthi wathi naye uyakholwa wukuthi lokhu kuzosiza kunciphise ubelelesi.Uthe kodwa ukutshalwa kwenqwaba yamaphoyisa ngeke kusize ngalutho uma ezobunhloli zingekho bukhali.“Ngisakhala ngithi kumele kubuyiswe uphiko lwamaphoyisa olwavalwa iSerious and Violent Crime Unit. Lolu phiko lwasebenza ngenkulu impumelelo futhi amanye amaphoyisa ayesebenza kulona asekhona embuthweni,” kusho uBurger.Uthe ufisa futhi ukuthi kusungulwe i-Anti Corruption Unit ngaphakathi emaphoyiseni ezobhekana ngqo nenkohlakalo.

Kuthiwa lesi sigameko senzeke kuyoshaya u-7 ntambama.IPhini loMkhulumeli we-IFP kuzwelonke uMnuz Joshua Mazibuko, uthe bafe olwembiza ngalo mholi obekhombisa ukukhalipha kodwa esemncane."Le nsizwa besigadla ngayo njengoba ibibuye ibe umholi wentsha Olundi, silimele kakhulu ngokuhamba kwayo. Asifuni-ke ukuqala sishaye amathambo siqagele ngoba kuyahlupha lokho. Sizodedela amaphoyisa enze umsebenzi wawo ukuze sithole kahle ukuthi bekwenzenjani,’’ kusho uMazibuko.Kwesinye isigameko ikhansela le-ANC emkhandlwini uMsunduzi ebelibuye libe umholi oqavile esifundeni iMoses Mabhida, nalo lisocongwe ngobusuku obufanayo. Kwenzeka lesi sigameko nje, sivele isimo simanzonzo kulesi sifunda njengoba kuze kwamiswa nengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi kwesabelwa ukuphepha kwabantu.UMnuz Musawenkosi ‘Qashana’ Mchunu (45) uthelekelwe amadoda angaziwa ngakwaPata, eMgungundlovu ehamba ngemoto yakhe ngo-7 ntambama. Kuthiwa la madoda avulele ngenhlamvu waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela, kwafika kwamenela.Umxhumanisi ebuholini besikhashana be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sihle Zikalala, kuthiwa uhlangabezane nembibizane exoshwa kubo kukamufi."Angixoshwanga nginqume ukuthi ngingangeni ngoba ngibona amaqabane ehlukene phakathi kunezinhlangothi ezimbili. source: abanalo isasasa ngemiphumela asebelinde iminyaka emine
text: BAPHILA ngokubamba amatoho abafundi osekuphele iminyaka emine belinde imiphumela yabo yezivivinyo zika-matric.Abafundi baseMashiyamahle High eNdwedwe bathi abanalo igugu lemiphumela yokuchibiyela kwabo kwango-2015, umnyango oyikhiphe ngoMsombuluko ngoba sebelahlekelwe yisikhathi esiningi lolu daba lusenkantolo. Bathi imiphumela yabo bafisa ukuyithola kummeli wabo okunguye abamqoka ukuthi abamele kulolu daba hhayi emnyangweni.UMthobisi Ntetha (23) uthe ubhuquza ekhaya ngemuva kokulahlekelwa umsebenzi wokuwasha izimoto eVerulam abewenza nyakenye.Uthe akakayi kobheka le miphumela okuthiwa abayilande ngoba ngokwazi kwakhe akuyona le abayifunayo.“Thina saya enkantolo ngoba singagculisekile ngokuthi umnyango usola ukuthi sakopela kodwa abukho ubufakazi obubambekayo. Esakuzwa ukuthi umnyango wathi washayelwa ucingo watshelwa ukuthi sikopelile. Sasifuna ukuthi inkantolo iphoqe umnyango ukuthi usinike leyo miphumela, le abayikhiphayo yokuchibiyela ilungile ngoba isinika ithuba elingcono lokuzikhethela kodwa akuyona le ebesiyilwela yonke le minyaka emine, yingakho ngingayanga koyilanda,” kusho uNtetha.Uthe ukungayitholi imiphumela yakhe kumenze walahlekelwa yisikhathi sakhe okungabe wasisebenzisa wayofundela i-Electrical Engineering ayezimisele ukuyifunda.“Njengamanje nginengane engingakwazi ukuyondla ngendlela ngoba imisebenzi eminingi ifuna umuntu ono-matric mina anginawo. Angikwazi nokuqhubeka ngiyofunda ngoba kufuneka sona isitifiketi sakwa-matric noma imiphumela, anginako kokubili,” kusho uNtetha.UBhekani Ngcobo (24), naye obeselinde imiphumela iminyaka emine, uthe uzwile ngaleyo miphumela kodwa akayilandanga ngoba akuyona abeyilindele.UNgcobo uthe ugcine esephoqeleka ukuthi afundele ukuthunga okuyinto abengayithandi ngoba ubengenabo ubufakazi bokuthi wawufunda u-matric.“Ngangifuna ukwenza iHuman Resource Management kodwa angikwazanga ngenxa yemiphumela yami eyabanjwa ngo-2014. Kubuhlungu okwenzeka kithi ngoba ababefunda ngemuva kwethu bayaqeda ukufunda emanyuvesi, ngisho nabaselamayo nabo abafunda kuso lesi sikole ngemuva kwethu ababanga nankinga, thina sibambekile kuthiwa sakopela kodwa abukho ubufakazi esitshelwa bona bokuthi sakopela,” kusho yena.UNtetha noNgcobo bangabanye ababafundibaka-matric ngo-2014 ababanjelwa imiphumelaya yabo. Uthishanhloko walesi sikole, uMnuz Zacharia Ntanzi, wamiswa kulesi sikole ngo-Agasti esolwa ngokugovuza abafundi abase bevala amasango ezikole zakule ndawo ngawo * -Agasti.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Kwazi Mthethwa, ukuvumile ukuthi uNtanzi washintshelwa kwesinye isikole ngempoqo njengoba umnyango usaqhubeka nokumphenya ngezinsolo zokuthi wasiza abafundi ukuthi bakopele.
“Izinqumo kufanele zitha thwe ngokushesha futhi kume le ucabange ngaphandle koku thatha isikhathi eside. Ngaphinde ngafunda ukuthi kuxhunyanwa kanjani neziguli,” engeza.

text: Bantabami ngokuzithoba ngiyacela isale seyimiswa le Khomishini kaZondo okuthiwa ngeyophenya ngokulawulwa koMbuso yidlanzana. Ngicabanga ukuthi nobengaboni useyabona manje ukuthi iKhomishini yokulawulwa koMbuso yidlanzana ifana nenunu emakhandakhanda ezoshaya ibhuqe u-ANC. Ukube nginawo amandla okufinyelela egoseni le Khomoshini yokulawulwa koMbuso yidlanzana, uSolwazi uThuli Madonsela, kungabe ngiyambuza manje ukuthi uyathokoza yini njengoba abantu bakaKhongolose sebejikijelana ngemikhonto ongathi baloyiwe. Kungenzeka ukuthi leKhomishini yasungulwa ngoba kuhloswe ukuthi kwembulwe izinqe zikaZuma kodwa manje kubukeka sekuvela nezinqe zabantu abaningi.Ngisho ingane ekhasela eziko iyabona ukuthi kule khomishini kuhujwa inyamazane eyodwa enguZuma kodwa kugcina sekulimala nezinye izinyamazane ngenxa yokuthi abazingeli bazingela ngokushisa umlilo. MaSolezwe ngiyaphinda ngiyasho ukuthi lo mlilo obaswe kuleya Khomishini uyoshiya uKhongolose ushe wahanguka amashiya nezinkophe. Lezi gubhu ezishawayo kuthiwe uKhongolose ubumbene ngibona ongathi kusiniswa amahleza ngoba le Khomishini ikuveza obala ukuthi uhlakazeke phakathi okwamaqhezu ezinqe. Okufike kube yinkinga wukuthi ofakazi beza ngogqozi nofuqufuqu lokupenda uZuma njengesikhohlakali kodwa bagcine sebechaphazele noGwede Mantashe, uGodongwana noJeff Radebe sekuvela ukuthi babekhona emihlanganweni ethile. OkaVolos uthi le Khomishini kaZondo ifana nomgangela wezinsizwa nezintokazi zikaKhongolose okufanele umiswe ngokushesha ngoba kuyofikwa okhethweni sekukhishwene amehlo abanye bengasanamazinyo. Kuyishwa ukuthi amalungu ka-ANC abukeka engaboni ukuthi ukuyofakaza kule Khomishini kufana nokuthatha intambo uzikhunge ngoba ugcine usungene wavela ngesicoco. Ubufakazi bale nto engiyishoyo kube yisehlo esehlele uNhlanhla Nene osukwe wusinga wayokwethula ubufakazi kodwa wagcina eselahlekelwa yisikhundla sokuba uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali. Kufikisela ngosizi ukubona uPravin Ghordan efakaza, echaza ukuthi yena wakubona kanjani ukulawulwa koMbuso. UMatamela kufanele ngabe usebonile ukuthi umuntu oyofakaza kule Khomishini usuke eqiqinge umgqomo kadoti eyowuchitha ngenhloso yokungcolisa abathile. Inkinga isekutheni ngesikhathi uchitha udoti uthi ungcolisa abantu ugcina nawe sewungcoliswe yilo doti owuchithayo. Bakwethu, mina nginovalo lokuthi ngelinye ilanga noZuma uyosukwa yikhanda lakhe aqiqinge amanabukeni angcolile kaKhongolose ayowachitha kule Khomishini kaZondo kuhayize abantu.MaSolezwe, ngiyazi uVolos waziwa njengesibhedi kodwa mina angikuboni ukubheda uma kungathiwa le Khomishini kaZondo imiswe okwesikhashana ngenxa yokushoda kwezimali. Kuyiqiniso ukuthi kuyosuka umsindo kube nemibuzo yokuthi imiswe kanjani iKhomishini isanda kuqala umsebenzi wayo. text: WAFIKA eThekwini ezonakekela indodakazi eyashayiswa yimoto owesifazane osehlala nomndeni wakhe ehlathini eWestville, eThekwini.Sekuphele iminyaka emithathu uNksz Bonisiwe Dlamini ehlala ehlathini nezingane eziyisihlanu. Amadodana kaNksz Dlamini okunguSphiwe Dlamini (30) noZamani Dlamini (23) abhadla ejele ngamacala ahlukene, nawo abehlala kuleli hlathi. Umzukulu okuthiwa walaxazwa ngunina, uzalwa ngenye yamadodana asejele.Indlela eya kulo mjondolo osehlathini idlula ezihlahleni eziminyene. ZITHOLE ithuba lokugonyuluka okokuqala ngokuhlukunyezwa kwazo ezinye izitshudeni zasemanyuvesi ebeziyingxenye yomcimbi obekudingidwa kuwo ngokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane emanyuvesi.UNksz Nonjabulo Mncwabe, ofunda e-UKZN eHoward, ugonyuluke ngokuthi ngonyaka odlule udlwengulwe umuntu obewumngani wakhe omnike indawo yokuhlala. Uthe akakwazanga ukukhuluma ngale nto ngenxa yokuthi yamkhubaza emoyeni ngoba engazitsheli ukuthi umuntu asondelene naye angamenza into enje. Uthe uze wakwazi ukukhuluma ngalesi sehlo okokuqala njengoba bekunenkulumo ngalesi sihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane izolo ngesikhathi kuhlangene izitshudeni eziphuma emanyuvesi ehlukene nezikhulu zezinhlaka ezehlukene eCoastal TVET College kwa-V eMlaza.Esinye isitshudeni, u-Amanda Zoleka, siveze ukuthi sathwalwa sifunda uGrade 10 sathola ukuthi nguyise owayehlele ukuthi amshadise esemncane. Sesishadisiwe sakhulelwa, saphuphunyelwa isisu sineminyaka engu-15. Sesisesibhedlela sathola usizo lwabezenhlalakahle sakwazi ukuphuma kulo mshado.Uthishanhloko weCoastal College eThekwini, uMnuz S B Ndlovu, uthe abazali kumele banakekele izingane zabo bahlale nazo ukuze bakwazi ukubona ukuthi yiziphi izingqinamba ezibhekana nazo zonke izinsuku.IPhini likaNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakame kuzwelonke, uMnuz Bhuti Manamela, livule lo mcimbi ngokuthi licele ukuthi kube nomzuzu wokuthula, kukhunjulwa bonke abesifazane ababulawa amadoda abebethandana nawo kubona abale uZolile Khumalo owayefunda eMangosuthu noJabulile Nhlapo owayefunda e-Unisa, eVanderbilpark. “Ukubulawa kwabantu besifazane abayizitshudeni kuyalikhinyabeza izinga lezemfundo njengoba ukuhlukunyezwa kwabantu besimame kungenye yezinkinga esibhekene nazo emanyuvesi. Njengoba kuqala inyanga yabantu abasha sizosebenzisa le nyanga ukuqwashisa izitshudeni ngokubhebhetheka kokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu besifazane emanyuvesi.”Uthe bazoba nezinhlelo ezibonakalayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuyaliwa nokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu besimame emanyuvesi.“Lezi zinhlelo sizoziqala kuwo amanyuvesi sithi: ‘phansi ngokuhlunyezwa kwabantu besimame, phansi, phansi ngama-blesser phansi.’ Sithi sekwanele ngokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu besimame.”Kuwona lo mcimbi kukhonjiswe nomdlalo washashalazi othi iKomeng, obhalwe waqondiswa umlingisi wakuleli uSello Maake kaNcube.Ekhuluma neSolezwe uthe i-iKomeng indlela akhethe ukukhuluma ngayo nabantu besilisa.“Ngalo mdlalo waseshashalazini ngifuna ukunika abantu besilisa umyalezo ngoba kungathi kukhona izinto ezibakhathazayo abangakwazi ukukhuluma ngazo. Ngalo mdlalo ngiphinde ngikhuze abantu besilisa abenza imikhuba emibi emizimbeni yabantu besimame njengokubadlwengula. Ngifisa bazi ukuthi kabanalo igunya lokuzenzela noma yini emzimbeni yabantu besimame,’’ kusho uSello.Izitshudeni zasemanyuvesi ehlukene zisebenzise leli thuba ukuthi zigonyuluke ngezinye zezinkinga asebhekane nazo zokuhlukunyezwa.

Lensizwa eneminyaka engu-23, ithi umphakathi awuwuvali umlomo ngamagalelo ayo ekuthuthukiseni izinga lomdlalo we-hockey emphakathini njengoba waziwa ngokuthi ngowabantu bebala elimhlophe.Uthando lwakhe lwalo mdlalo lisuka kude njengoba laqala esenza amabanga aphansi eBonisanani Primary, okuyisikole esiseNtuzuma esigcemeni sakwaG.Akugcinanga lapho njengoba wagcina esethole umfundaze kwezinye zezikole zabadla izambane likapondo saseMhlanga esaziwa ngeNorthwood High nakholelwa ukuthi samsiza kakhulu ngokuthuthukisa izinga lakhe njengomdlali.INanda Seminary izoqala imidlalo yeminyaka yonke ebizwa nge Spar School Girls Hockey Challenge lapho bezobe beqhudelana nezikole eziyisithupha ezisenkabeni yeTheku okubalwa kuzo iDurban Girls High, Durban Girls College, Hoerskool Port Natal, Maris Stella, Ridge Park High neSt Henry. Lo mqhudelwano unamuhla use-3 Schools’ Trust astroturf, eGlenwood.“Ngicabanga ukuthi kumele sikushintshe ukuthi sibukele i-hockey njengomdlalo wabantu abamhlophe. Ngiqala ukuzibandakanya nalo mdlalo ngike ngabhekana nezingqinamba zokubukwa ngelinye iso emphakathini engiwakhele ngenxa yokuthi bebengaqondi kahle. Izinto seziqala ukujika manje njengoba kwezinye izikhathi ngimiswa abantu ubuthaphuthaphu befuna ngibacobelele ngolwazi enginalo nglo mdlalo,” kusho uButhelezi.Uthi yize ewumuntu omatasa ngenxa yomsebenzi njengoba engumabhalane kuMasipala weTheku kodwa akumkhinyabezi ukuthi aphinde adlalele ikilabhu yangakubo i-Ink Hockey Club edlala ngaphansi kwesigaba esiphezulu kwi-Durban Central.Ukumela iqembu lesifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal Hockey team, ngonyaka ka-2006 kwezinye zezinto eziyohlezi zimthokozisa kakhulu.Ukumela iqembu lesizwe kuseyiphupho alibona lisazofezeka njengoba ekholelwa kuthi iminyaka isangakuyena nanothando analo lalo mdlalo. Uzibophezele ekuqhubekeni nokutshala ulwazi emphakathini awakhele nawubona usukhombisa olukhulu ugqozi muva nje.Mekubalwa nabanye abantu asebenze lomdlalo wazakhela idumela eNanda alisali igama likaBongi Gabuza oqeqeshwa nguye uButhelezi.Le ntokazi edabuka eStanger KwaDukuza ikholelwa wukuthi kwayisiza kakhulu ukufunda esikoleni zabebala labamhlophe nekwenza yagcina isizibandakanya nalo mdlalo. Uthi waqala lomdlalo esaneminyaka eyisikhombisa esenza amabanga amancane eDarnall Primary School wangaphinda wabheka emuva kusukela lapho.“Uma ngikhuluma iqiniso, ngifike eNanda ngathola liphansi kakhulu izinga le-hockey ngoba besijwayele ukudlala nabantu abasezingeni kakhulu. Ushintsho lukhona impela kodwa kuzothatha isikhathi kuthi libe ngelincomekayo,” kugoqa Gabuza, owenza unyaka wesithathu enyuvesi yaseNingizimu Afrika ( Unisa) kwiziqu zobuthishela.Ukholelwa wukuthi uhulumeni akenzi lutho ekuxhaseni lolu hlobo lomdlalo ezindaweni zasemalokishini nabona kuyingqinamba eyenza lo mdlalo ungathuthuki ngalendlela elindelekile.Lo mdlali odlala emuva usehlale iminyaka emibili neNanda Seminary Hockey team nanethemba lokuthi libukeka liqhakazile ikusasa lalo mdlalo emphakathini njengoba uthando lwawo luqubuka mihla namalanga.Ngeminye imininingwane ungalandela ikhasi lomqhudelwano le-Facebook .

Unethimba eliqinisekisa ukuthi kunezimpahla ezingakhokhelwa intela iValue Added Tax (VAT) kodwa akanalo elibheka inkinga kaphethroli onyuka njalo,” kusho uHlengwa.Uveze ukuthi incwadi bayithumele ngoMsombuluko ngoba befuna uRamaphosa aphumele obala asho ukuthi yena nohulumeni we-ANC bami kuphi ngalolu daba lukaphethroli.Uzwakalise ukukhathazeka ngokuthi uSomlomo wePhalamende, uNksz Baleka Mbete wasichitha isicelo sabo sokuthi kukhulunywe ngodaba lokunyuka kukaphethroli ePhalamende.UHlengwa uthe ukunyuka kukaphethroli kuhlukumeza kakhulu abantu abampofu ngoba akunyuki wona kuphela kodwa kunyuka ukudla, ugesi nezinye izidingongqangi.“Sekuyisikhathi sokuthi uMengameli Ramaphosa ehlise ikhabhinethi yakhe enamalungu amaningi, alwe nenkohlakalo, aqinisekise ukuthi kuboshwa izifociya kuyo yonke iminyango kahulumeni ukuze leyo mali izofakwa kwintela kaphethroli,” kusho uHlengwa.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kukaRamaphosa ayiphumelelanga njengoba abehhovisi lakhe bengayiphendulanga imibuzo yeSolezwe.

USATHUTHUMELA owesifazane osinde ngesikhathi indoda yakhe idutshulwa ngentululwane yezinhlamvu ngamaphoyisa okuthiwa abephenya entathakusa yangoLwesine eNseleni.UNksz Sihle Mdletshe ubesendlini ngesikhathi kuhlaselwa emzini wabo noMnuz Bhekizenzo Msweli (66), odutshulwe amanxeba amathathu esifubeni wadlavazeka nengalo. UNksz Mdletshe uthe bebelele ngezithuba zabo-1 entathakusa ngesikhathi bezwa kukhonkotha inja egcekeni.“Sesake sangenelwa izigebengu phambilini zizogqekeza imoto. Izimoto ezimbili ubesezipaka eduze komnyango wendlu ukuze ezwe uma kukhona okungahambi kahle. Ngesikhathi inja ikhonkotha wavuka wathatha isibhamu sakhe esisemthethweni, wayovula umnyango wasekhishini lapho bekukhonkotha khona inja,” kuchaza uNksz Mdletshe.Uthe umufi ubesawuvula nje umnyango wezwa kuqhuma isibhamu. Uveze ukuthi wesabile ukuphuma, wezwa umufi ekhala ngokuthi uyafa.“Ungene ekamelweni esaphethe isibhamu, opha kakhulu esifubeni, wafike wawa. Ngizwe kukhona okuqhuma sengathi yibhomu ngasemnyango, ngavele ngaphuma sengiphakamise izandla ngizikhalela kuleli qulu lamadoda ebelisegcekeni. Bangiphushele emnyango bangena endlini bebuza ukuthi ngobani abanye abakhona. Ngibatshele ukuthi kunezingane ezilele kwelinye ikamelo,” kuchaza yena.Uthe kuleli qulu lamadoda bekukhona eyodwa egqoke umfaniswano wamaphoyisa. Usola ukuthi lama doda eqe uthango ngesikhathi engena egcekeni ngoba ebehamba ngezinyawo. Ubone kamuva ukuthi nephoyisa lidubulekile. Uthe la madoda acele awavulele isango efuna ukuvulela i-ambulensi. Emuva kwalesi sigameko uNksz Mdletshe uthe kufike amaphoyisa okuyilapho eqinisekise khona ukuthi nguzakwabo odutshuliwe.Uveze ukuthi usamangele ukuthi ubulaweleni uMsweli ngoba nesibhamu besisemthethweni. Umufi, okuthiwa ubethutha izingane zesikole, ushonele esibhedlela ngoLwesine ekuseni. UNksz Mdletshe uthe ngesikhathi behlaselwa yizigebengu ngo-2016 umufi waqhumisa isibhamu wagcina eboshiwe, waphucwa nesibhamu kodwa icala labuye laphela, nesibhamu sabuyiselwa kuye.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uCaptain Nqobile Gwala, uthe amaphoyisa abelandela uphenyo ngabasolwa abebefuneka ngamacala okuphanga nawokudlwengulwa enziwa ngo-2017.“Amaphoyisa angqongqozile azazisa kodwa kwakhona odubulayo ngaphakathi endlini kwadubuleka iphoyisa ekhandla. Amaphoyisa aphindisele ngenhlamvu kumufi odubuleke esifubeni.“Umufi utholakale nesibhamu ngaphambi kokuthi bayiswe esibhedlela nephoyisa. Kuvulwe icala lokubulala nelokuzama ukubulala, idokodo ladluliselwa kwi-Independent Police Investigative Directorate”.

text: UMHOLI we-Economic Freedom Fighters, uMnuz Julius Malema, usegxeke impatho etholwe uMnuz Duduzane Zuma ngesikhathi evela enkantolo izolo.UZuma ubevele enkantolo yamacala athinta imali wanikezwa ibheyili kaR100 000 ecaleni lenkohlakalo lapho esolwa ngokuthi wazama ukugwazela owayeyiPhini likaNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Mcebisi Jonas, ngoR600 million kodwa uJonas wawunqaba.Izolo uMbuso ubeke uDuduzane icala lenkohlakalo kodwa udaba olube sematheni kakhulu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ukuvela kwakhe efakwe ozankosi ezinyaweni, okuvame ukwenziwa uma kuvela abasolwa ababhekene namacala abucayi.Umbuzo obuhamba phambili ezinkundleni ngowokuthi ufakelweni ozankosi ngaloluya hlobo ekubeni kunguye ozinikele emaphoyiseni.Ekhuluma nentatheli yeSABC ngoLwesibili uMalema uthe uDuduzane usezoba yiqhawe kuleli ngoba abantu bazozwelana naye ngenxa yendlela aphathwe ngayo."Akumele senze abantu okungenzeka ukuthi baphule umthetho amaqhawe ngenxa yendlela esibaphatha ngayo. Buka into eyenzeke kuDuduzane. Namhlanje uDuduzane uyiqhawe ngenxa yendlela aphathwe ngayo enkantolo. Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bayazwelana nabantu ababukeka engathi bayizisulu. Akumele sihlasele abantu okungenzeka ukuthi bayizigebengu ngendlela ezobaphendula amaqhawe," kusho uMalema.Uqhube waveza nokuthi kumele abantu abasolwayo balandelelwe kuphela uma sekunobufakazi obanele ukuthi babhekane nengalo yomthetho enkantolo."Kunomehluko phakathi kwepolitiki necala elisenkantolo. Enkantolo kumele uveze ubufakazi obungashiyi ungabazane ngezinsolo umsolwa abekwa zona. UMalema ufike abange umsindo abange umsindo, bese beyagxuma abeNPA ngisho bengenabo ubufukazi. Ngakho kumele sikwazi ukukuhlukanisa lokhu kokubili. Sizoqhubeka sibange umsindo ngezinto esizisolayo kodwa oKlebe neNPA akumele badudwe ngabakuzwa ePhalamende. Kumele baqhubeke bona bayofuna ubufakazi, uma sebebutholile kumele baphathe abasolwa ngendlela ngoba ukungakwenzi lokhu kubaphendula amaqhawe," kuphetha uMalema.Icala likaDuduzane lihlehliselwe uJanuwari 24 wonyaka ozayo ngoba kusaqhubeka uphenyo.

text: KUBOSHWE umfundisi waseGeorge, eWestern Cape, nengoduso yakhe, basolwa ngokubulala owesifazane ngasekuqaleni kwenyanga kaJulayi ukuze bahlomule ngemali yomshwalense wempilo abese bemuthathele wona.UNksz Siphosile Pamba (25) okhalelwe ngamasongo kaSigonyela ngoLwesihlanu lwesonto eledlule, eZone 9 eThembalethu, uvele isikhasha enkantolo yeMantshi eGeorge izolo ngezinsolo zokubulala uNksz Hlompo Mohapi (25) ofihlwe ngoMgqibelo.Ngemuva kwakhe kube sekuboshwa umfundisi athandana naye uMfu Melisize Monqo (30) osolwa ngecala lokubulala nokukhwabanisa njengoba kuvele ukuthi wathatha umshwalense wempilo ngegama likaMohapi.Amaphoyisa aphinde athatha nemoto etholwe kuMfu Monqo.UHLOMPO Mohapi waseThembalethu ongcwatshwe ngoMgqibelo. KUYISITAYELA kwabanye ukuzithathela isinqumo sokungayi ocansini, iningi labo okungabesifazane abathi abazihlanganisi nendoda. Yize lokhu kujwayeleke kwabakholwayo, ukungayi ocansini okubizwa nge-celibacy ngomunye umkhuba osujoyinwe ngisho abangasindisiwe. Umuntu ozibophezela kulo mkhuba ubizwa nge-celibate ngoba usuke ezinqumele ukuthi ngeke aye ocansini.UNksz Amanda Ndiki obizwa ngeQueen of Celibacy njengoba eseneminyaka eyisithupha engayi ocansini, uthe akaluhaleli nhlobo ucansi noma indoda.UNksz Ndiki (38) obuye abe ngumvangeli, uthe ukuba yi-celibate akuhlangene kuphela nenkolo kodwa yisinqumo somuntu. Encwadini yakhe ethi Stepping Into Your True Self, uyachaza ngalesi sinqumo sakhe.Uthe isikhathi esiningi umuntu usuke efuna ukuzithola ukuthi yini emjabulisayo, azinike isikhathi ngokuzazi kabanzi. Yize abanye bethi lo mkhuba ngowabesifazane, uthe bakhona nabesilisa abazinqumela ukuba ngama-celibate.“Kwesinye isikhathi senza izinto ngoba nakhu abanye bezenza njengakho ukuya ocansini. Ngokwabantu uma ujola kumele uye ocansini kanti akumele kube njalo. Uma uzikhethela ukungayi ocansini usuke ufuna ukukhombisa ukuthi awulawulwa yimizwa yakho. Abanye baya ocansini ngisho bengathandi kodwa ngoba kumele kwenzeke,” echaza.Uveze ukuthi ukuzithathela isinqumo sokungayi ocansini usuke ugwema ukugcina ulala nabantu abaningi ngoba kuyenzeka ubudlelwano buphele, udlulele phambili. Uthe ukulala nomuntu kwenza unamathele kuye ngokomoya, yingakho abanye bekhetha ukungayi nhlobo ocansini.Ezinye izizathu athe zenza abanye bathathe lesi sinqumo, ukuthi basuke befuna ukuphola uma kungahambanga kahle ebudlelwaneni bezothando.UNksz Ndiki ucacise ngokuthi kwehlukene ukuzithiba ocansini okubizwa nge-abstinence nesinqumo sokuba yi-celibate.“Ungakwazi ukuzithiba ocansini kodwa usebenzise ezinye izindlela zokujabulisa imizwa yakho. Uma uyi-celibate awuzijabulisi ngalutho kodwa ugwema konke okuhambisana nocansi. Uma uzithiba usuke uzibekele isikhathi esithize kodwa kwi-celibacy kuyenzeka uzibekele lesi sinqumo ingunaphakade,” kusho yena.UNksz Ndiki oke washada wabuye wahlukanisa, uyavuma ukuthi akulula kulesi sinqumo. Uthe uma usaqala ukusithatha kungcono ungajoli nhlobo ukuze ugweme izilingo. Yize abanye abangama-celibate bejola, yena uthe akajoli nhlobo futhi akanasizungu sendoda. Ukugwema izilingo uthe kubalulekile ukungabuki izinhlelo zethelevishini ezizovusa imizwa.Owesifazane ocele ukungadalulwa, uthe wathatha lesi sinqumo eminyakeni emine edlule emuva kokuphoxeka emshadweni. Uthe wayevele ezinqumele ukuthi uyolala nomuntu ayoshada naye kuphela . Kuthe uma behlukana naye wazinqumela ukuthi ngeke aphinde aye ocansini nenye indoda.UNksz Zola Dudeni oyiPscychologist uthe ezinye izizathu ezidala abantu bathathe lesi sinqumo kubalwa ukudlwengulwa, ukulinda umshado nokuhlukumezeka ebudlelwaneni. Uthe abanye basuke bengaluthandi ngokwemvelo ucansi, athe babizwa ngama-asexuals.
